```css
  color: #ba1a1a;
}

.session-error h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.session-error p {
  color: #515f74;
  margin: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   SHARED NAV
═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.precheck-shell .session-nav,
.live-shell .session-nav,
.completed-shell .session-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1.2rem 2rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edeef0;
  background: #fff;
}

.nav-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.brand-icon-wrap {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  background: #1e3a8a;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.brand-name {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: #1e3a8a;
  line-height: 1;
}

.brand-sub {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #757682;
  margin-top: 3px;
}

.nav-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #757682;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.live-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: #e7e8ea;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #444651;
}

.live-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #ba1a1a;
  animation: live-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes live-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); }
}

.btn-nav-back {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  background: #fff;
  color: #444651;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.btn-nav-back:hover {
  border-color: #4059aa;
  color: #4059aa;
}

.btn-back {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: #00236f;
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.btn-back:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   PRE-CHECK
═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.precheck-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #f8f9fb;
}

.precheck-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 2rem 1.5rem 4rem;
  gap: 2rem;
}

.precheck-intro {
  text-align: center;
}

.precheck-intro h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.precheck-intro p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #515f74;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.precheck-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 840px;
}

.check-card {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e2e4;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.4rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

.check-card h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #191c1e;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.check-card h3 i { color: #4059aa; }

/* Camera preview */
.camera-preview-wrap {
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #191c1e;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.preview-video {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

.no-camera-placeholder {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  color: #757682;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.no-cam-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  opacity: 0.4;
  color: #fff;
}

/* Permission list */
.perm-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.perm-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #444651;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #f3f4f6;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.perm-item.perm-granted {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  border-color: #b5e6ca;
  color: #1f6841;
}

.perm-item.perm-denied {
  background: #fff3f2;
  border-color: #ffdad6;
  color: #ba1a1a;
}

.perm-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #c5c5d3;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.perm-granted .perm-dot { background: #1f6841; }
.perm-denied .perm-dot { background: #ba1a1a; }

.perm-icon { font-size: 0.85rem; }

.perm-badge {
  margin-left: auto;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.perm-ok { background: #def8e9; color: #1f6841; }
.perm-fail { background: #ffdad6; color: #ba1a1a; }
.perm-warn { background: #fffbeb; color: #92400e; }
.perm-pending { background: #e7e8ea; color: #757682; }

/* Grant perms button */
.btn-grant-perms {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: #4059aa;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.2rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.btn-grant-perms:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }

/* Rules list */
.rules-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.rules-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  color: #444651;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.rules-list li i {
  color: #4059aa;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
  width: 16px;
  text-align: center;
}

.browser-events-warning {
  background: #ffdad6;
  border: 1px solid #f8d3d0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #ba1a1a;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

/* Start CTA */
.precheck-cta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.cta-note {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #757682;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.btn-start-session {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00236f, #4059aa);
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(64, 89, 170, 0.4);
  transition: transform 0.15s, opacity 0.15s;
}

.btn-start-session:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(1.04); }
.btn-start-session:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   LIVE SESSION
═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.live-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #f8f9fb;
}

.live-main {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 2rem;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

/* ── AI Arena ── */
.arena-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
}

.ai-arena {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #1e3a8a 0%, #00164e 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 22, 78, 0.4);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Orb background layers */
.orb-layer {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(40px);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.orb-blue {
  width: 80%;
  height: 80%;
  top: -10%;
  left: -10%;
  background: #4059aa;
  opacity: 0.35;
  animation: orb-pulse 8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.orb-teal {
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
  bottom: -10%;
  right: -10%;
  background: #10b981;
  opacity: 0.25;
  animation: orb-pulse 10s ease-in-out infinite 2s;
}

@keyframes orb-pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.3; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 0.45; }
}

/* Kinetic rings */
.kinetic-orbit {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.orbit-outer {
  width: 260px;
  height: 260px;
  animation: orbit-rotate 20s linear infinite;
  border-color: rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.15);
}

.orbit-inner {
  width: 190px;
  height: 190px;
  animation: orbit-rotate 14s linear infinite reverse;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

@keyframes orbit-rotate {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* AI Core glow */
.ai-core-glow {
  position: absolute;
  width: 180px;
  height: 180px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.3) 0%, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0) 70%);
  filter: blur(24px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Waveform bars */
.waveform-center {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 5px;
  height: 64px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.wave-bar {
  width: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  border-radius: 4px;
  animation: wave-idle 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin: bottom;
  min-height: 8px;
}

.wave-bar:nth-child(3n) { background: rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.85); }
.wave-bar:nth-child(3n+1) { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); }

.wave-bar--speaking {
  animation: wave-bounce 0.65s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}

@keyframes wave-idle {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35); opacity: 0.45; }
  50% { transform: scaleY(0.65); opacity: 0.75; }
}

@keyframes wave-bounce {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.3); }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

/* AI Status label */
.ai-status-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 14px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 3;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ai-status-label span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

/* PiP camera */
.pip-container {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 16px;
  right: 16px;
  width: 192px;
  height: 128px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #2a2a3d;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  z-index: 5;
}

.pip-video {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

.pip-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  color: #6b7280;
  background: #374151;
}

.pip-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 6px;
  left: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.45rem;
}

.pip-live-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #4edea3;
  animation: live-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* ── Controls Bar ── */
.controls-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.timer-pill,
.progress-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #191c1e;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
}

.timer-pill i,
.progress-pill i {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #4059aa;
}

.btn-end-interview {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  background: #ba1a1a;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(186, 26, 26, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.12s;
}

.btn-end-interview:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(1.04); }
.btn-end-interview:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

.btn-control-circle {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  background: #fff;
  color: #444651;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
}

.btn-control-circle:hover { border-color: #4059aa; color: #4059aa; }
.btn-control--active { background: #e7e8ea; }

/* ── Transcript Panel ── */
.transcript-panel {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e2e4;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.transcript-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edeef0;
}

.transcript-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: #515f74;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.transcript-title i { color: #4059aa; }

.ai-active-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #00311f;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.7rem;
  background: rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.15);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.ai-active-chip i { color: #27c38a; }

.transcript-feed {
  padding: 1.5rem;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.2rem;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

.transcript-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.transcript-empty-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  color: #c5c5d3;
}

.transcript-empty p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #757682;
}

/* Bubbles */
.transcript-bubble {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.bubble-avatar {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.bubble--ai .bubble-avatar { background: #1e3a8a; color: #fff; }
.bubble--candidate .bubble-avatar { background: #e7e8ea; color: #444651; }
.bubble--system .bubble-avatar { background: #d5e3fc; color: #515f74; }

.bubble-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.bubble-role {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: #757682;
}

.bubble-text {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.bubble--candidate .bubble-text { font-style: italic; opacity: 0.85; }

.bubble-speaking::after {
  content: ' ▌';
  animation: cursor-blink 0.8s step-end infinite;
  color: #4059aa;
}

@keyframes cursor-blink {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0; }
}

/* Integrity bar */
.integrity-bar {
  margin: 0.5rem 1.5rem 1rem;
  background: #fffbeb;
  border: 1px solid #fde68a;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #92400e;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

/* ── Confirm End Dialog ── */
.confirm-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(25, 28, 30, 0.75);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

.confirm-dialog {
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 2.5rem;
  max-width: 420px;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.confirm-icon {
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #ffdad6;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: #ba1a1a;
}

.confirm-dialog h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.confirm-dialog p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #515f74;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.confirm-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.btn-confirm-cancel {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #444651;
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.btn-confirm-cancel:hover { border-color: #4059aa; }

.btn-confirm-end {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #ba1a1a;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.btn-confirm-end:hover:not(:disabled) { opacity: 0.9; }
.btn-confirm-end:disabled, .btn-confirm-cancel:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   COMPLETED SCREEN
═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.completed-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #f8f9fb;
}

.completed-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 3rem 2rem;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.completed-icon {
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2rem;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
}

.completed-body h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.completed-body > p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #515f74;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  max-width: 460px;
}

.completed-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.completed-stats .stat-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e2e4;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #444651;
}

.completed-stats .stat-chip i { color: #4059aa; }

.completed-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.btn-view-report {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00236f, #4059aa);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(64, 89, 170, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.12s;
}

.btn-view-report:hover { transform: scale(1.03); }

.btn-back-interviews {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #444651;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.btn-back-interviews:hover { border-color: #4059aa; color: #4059aa; }

/* ── Session Footer ── */
.session-footer {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

.session-footer p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #9ca3af;
}

/* ── Shared spinner ── */
.btn-spinner {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  border-top-color: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: jl-spin 0.75s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes jl-spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .precheck-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .controls-bar { gap: 0.6rem; }
  .btn-end-interview span { display: none; }

  .pip-container {
    width: 120px;
    height: 80px;
    bottom: 8px;
    right: 8px;
  }

  .precheck-shell .session-nav,
  .live-shell .session-nav,
  .completed-shell .session-nav {
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  }
}
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/interviews/candidate-interview-session.page.html`
```html
<!-- ── Loading ── -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'loading') {
  <div class="session-loading">
    <div class="loading-spinner"></div>
    <p>Loading your interview session…</p>
  </div>
}

<!-- ── Error ── -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'error') {
  <div class="session-error">
    <div class="error-icon-wrap">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
    </div>
    <h2>Session Unavailable</h2>
    <p>{{ error() || 'This interview session could not be loaded.' }}</p>
    <a class="btn-back" routerLink="/candidate/interviews">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Back to Interviews
    </a>
  </div>
}

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     PRE-CHECK SCREEN
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'pre-check' && session(); as s) {
  <div class="precheck-shell">
    <!-- Top bar -->
    <nav class="session-nav">
      <div class="nav-brand">
        <div class="brand-icon-wrap">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span class="brand-name">JobLens</span>
          <span class="brand-sub">Enterprise Recruiting</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span class="nav-label">Interview Pre-Check</span>
      <a class="btn-nav-back" routerLink="/candidate/interviews">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Back
      </a>
    </nav>

    <div class="precheck-body">
      <!-- Title -->
      <div class="precheck-intro">
        <h1>{{ s.interviewTitle || s.jobTitle }}</h1>
        <p>{{ s.jobTitle }} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {{ s.agentType }} AI Agent Interview</p>
      </div>

      <div class="precheck-cards">
        <!-- Camera & Mic card -->
        <div class="check-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i> Camera &amp; Microphone</h3>

          <div class="camera-preview-wrap">
            @if (cameraStream()) {
              <video #previewVideo autoplay muted playsinline class="preview-video"></video>
            } @else {
              <div class="no-camera-placeholder">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-camera-slash no-cam-icon"></i>
                <span>Camera not enabled</span>
                <small>Grant access below to preview your camera</small>
              </div>
            }
          </div>

          <ul class="perm-list">
            <li class="perm-item" [class.perm-granted]="permissionsGranted().mic" [class.perm-denied]="permChecked() && !permissionsGranted().mic">
              <span class="perm-dot"></span>
              <i class="fa-solid fa-microphone perm-icon"></i>
              Microphone
              @if (permissionsGranted().mic) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-ok"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Ready</span>
              } @else if (permChecked()) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-fail"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i> Denied — required</span>
              } @else {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-pending">Not checked</span>
              }
            </li>
            <li class="perm-item" [class.perm-granted]="permissionsGranted().camera" [class.perm-denied]="permChecked() && !permissionsGranted().camera">
              <span class="perm-dot"></span>
              <i class="fa-solid fa-camera perm-icon"></i>
              Camera
              @if (permissionsGranted().camera) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-ok"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Ready</span>
              } @else if (permChecked()) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-fail"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i> Denied — required</span>
              } @else {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-pending">Not checked</span>
              }
            </li>
          </ul>

          @if (!hasRequiredPermissions()) {
            <button class="btn-grant-perms" type="button" (click)="requestPermissions()" [disabled]="requestingPerms()">
              @if (requestingPerms()) {
                <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Requesting access…
              } @else {
                <i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i> Grant Mic &amp; Camera Access
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>

        <!-- Guidelines card -->
        <div class="check-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-list"></i> Interview Guidelines</h3>
          <ul class="rules-list">
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i> Find a quiet environment with good lighting</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i> Keep your camera on and look directly at the screen</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-ban"></i> Do not switch browser tabs during the interview</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i> Speak clearly — the AI will transcribe your responses</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-clock"></i> Each response has a suggested time limit</li>
          </ul>

          @if (hasBrowserEvents()) {
            <div class="browser-events-warning">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
              {{ totalBrowserEvents() }} integrity event(s) detected
            </div>
          }
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Start button -->
      <div class="precheck-cta">
        @if (!hasRequiredPermissions()) {
          <p class="cta-note">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i>
            Grant microphone and camera access before starting.
          </p>
        }
        <button
          class="btn-start-session"
          type="button"
          (click)="enterInterview()"
          [disabled]="acting() || !hasRequiredPermissions()"
        >
          @if (acting()) {
            <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Starting…
          } @else {
            <i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i> Start Interview
          }
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
}

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     LIVE SESSION
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
@if ((interviewPhase() === 'in-progress' || interviewPhase() === 'completing') && session(); as s) {
  <div class="live-shell">

    <!-- ── Top Nav ── -->
    <nav class="session-nav">
      <div class="nav-brand">
        <div class="brand-icon-wrap">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span class="brand-name">JobLens</span>
          <span class="brand-sub">Enterprise Recruiting</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="live-badge">
        <span class="live-dot"></span>
        <span>Live Session</span>
      </div>
    </nav>

    <main class="live-main">
      <!-- ── AI Arena ── -->
      <div class="arena-wrap">
        <div class="ai-arena">
          <!-- Background orb layers -->
          <div class="orb-layer orb-blue"></div>
          <div class="orb-layer orb-teal"></div>

          <!-- Kinetic rotating rings -->
          <div class="kinetic-orbit orbit-outer"></div>
          <div class="kinetic-orbit orbit-inner"></div>

          <!-- AI Core glow -->
          <div class="ai-core-glow"></div>

          <!-- Central waveform bars -->
          <div class="waveform-center">
            @for (bar of waveformBars; track bar.delay) {
              <div
                class="wave-bar"
                [class.wave-bar--speaking]="audioPlaying() || liveCapturing()"
                [style.animation-duration]="bar.dur + 's'"
                [style.animation-delay]="bar.delay + 's'"
                [style.height.px]="bar.h"
              ></div>
            }
          </div>

          <!-- AI status label -->
          <div class="ai-status-label">
            @if (audioPlaying()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i> AI Speaking</span>
            } @else if (aiSpeechMode() === 'fallback') {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i> AI Voice (Fallback)</span>
            } @else if (liveCapturing()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i> Listening…</span>
            } @else if (isRealtimeConnecting()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i> Connecting…</span>
            } @else if (aiConnected()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-plug-circle-check"></i> AI Connected</span>
            } @else {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-stars"></i> AI Ready</span>
            }
          </div>

          <!-- PiP candidate camera -->
          <div class="pip-container">
            @if (cameraStream()) {
              <video #arenaVideo autoplay muted playsinline class="pip-video"></video>
            } @else {
              <div class="pip-placeholder">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i>
              </div>
            }
            <div class="pip-label">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i> You
            </div>
            <div class="pip-live-dot"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Controls Bar ── -->
      <div class="controls-bar">
        <!-- Timer -->
        <div class="timer-pill">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-stopwatch"></i>
          <span>{{ formattedTimer() }}</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Progress -->
        <div class="progress-pill">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check"></i>
          <span>{{ answeredCount() }} / {{ totalCount() }}</span>
        </div>

        <!-- End interview -->
        <button
          class="btn-end-interview"
          type="button"
          (click)="endSession()"
          [disabled]="acting()"
        >
          <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i>
          <span>End Interview</span>
        </button>

        <!-- Realtime status -->
        @if (canUseRealtime()) {
          @if (!isRealtimeConnected()) {
            <button class="btn-control-circle" type="button" (click)="connectRealtime()" title="Reconnect AI">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate" [class.fa-spin]="isRealtimeConnecting()"></i>
            </button>
          } @else {
            <button
              class="btn-control-circle btn-control--active"
              type="button"
              [disabled]="true"
              title="Microphone is locked during live interview"
            >
              <i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i>
            </button>
          }
        }

        <div class="progress-pill">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i>
          <span>{{ cameraMonitoringActive() ? 'Camera Monitoring Active' : 'Camera Monitoring Idle' }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Live Transcript ── -->
      <div class="transcript-panel">
        <div class="transcript-header">
          <h3 class="transcript-title">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-comments"></i> Live Conversation
          </h3>
          <div class="ai-active-chip">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i>
            AI Active
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="transcript-feed" #transcriptFeed>
          @if (!hasTranscripts()) {
            <div class="transcript-empty">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-comment-dots transcript-empty-icon"></i>
              <p>The conversation will appear here once the interview begins.</p>
            </div>
          }

          @for (entry of transcriptEntries(); track entry.createdAtIso) {
            <div class="transcript-bubble" [class.bubble--ai]="entry.role === 'assistant'" [class.bubble--candidate]="entry.role === 'candidate'" [class.bubble--system]="entry.role === 'system'">
              <div class="bubble-avatar">
                @if (entry.role === 'assistant') {
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i>
                } @else if (entry.role === 'candidate') {
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i>
                } @else {
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i>
                }
              </div>
              <div class="bubble-body">
                <span class="bubble-role">
                  @if (entry.role === 'assistant') { Interviewer }
                  @else if (entry.role === 'candidate') { You }
                  @else { System }
                </span>
                <p class="bubble-text" [class.bubble-speaking]="entry.role === 'candidate' && liveCapturing()">
                  {{ entry.text }}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          }
        </div>

        <!-- Integrity warning -->
        @if (hasBrowserEvents()) {
          <div class="integrity-bar">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i>
            {{ totalBrowserEvents() }} integrity event(s) logged
          </div>
        }
        @if (hasProctoringEvents()) {
          <div class="integrity-bar">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i>
            Live camera alerts: {{ proctoringEvents().join(' | ') }}
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </main>

    <footer class="session-footer">
      <p>JobLens Kinetic &nbsp;•&nbsp; Secure Candidate Environment</p>
    </footer>
  </div>

  <!-- ── End Session Confirm Dialog ── -->
  @if (confirmEndSessionOpen()) {
    <div class="confirm-overlay">
      <div class="confirm-dialog">
        <div class="confirm-icon">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i>
        </div>
        <h2>End Interview?</h2>
        <p>This will finalize your session. You cannot re-enter once ended.</p>
        <div class="confirm-actions">
          <button class="btn-confirm-cancel" type="button" (click)="confirmEndSessionOpen.set(false)" [disabled]="acting()">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Continue Session
          </button>
          <button class="btn-confirm-end" type="button" (click)="confirmEndSession()" [disabled]="acting()">
            @if (acting()) {
              <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Ending…
            } @else {
              <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i> End Now
            }
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  }

  @if (leaveWarningOpen()) {
    <div class="confirm-overlay">
      <div class="confirm-dialog">
        <div class="confirm-icon">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-door-open"></i>
        </div>
        <h2>Leaving Is Restricted</h2>
        <p>
          This is your first leave attempt. If you try to leave again, the interview will end automatically and your score will be computed from captured answers.
        </p>
        <div class="confirm-actions">
          <button class="btn-confirm-cancel" type="button" (click)="dismissLeaveWarning()" [disabled]="acting()">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Continue Interview
          </button>
          <button class="btn-confirm-end" type="button" (click)="endSessionAfterLeaveWarning()" [disabled]="acting()">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i> End Interview Now
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  }
}

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     COMPLETED
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'completed') {
  <div class="completed-shell">
    <nav class="session-nav">
      <div class="nav-brand">
        <div class="brand-icon-wrap">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span class="brand-name">JobLens</span>
          <span class="brand-sub">Enterprise Recruiting</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>

    <div class="completed-body">
      <div class="completed-icon">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-trophy"></i>
      </div>
      <h1>Interview Complete!</h1>
      <p>
        Great work! Your responses have been recorded and will be reviewed by our AI.
        You'll be notified once your report is ready.
      </p>

      <div class="completed-stats">
        <div class="stat-chip">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check"></i>
          {{ answeredCount() }} / {{ totalCount() }} Questions
        </div>
        <div class="stat-chip">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-stopwatch"></i>
          {{ formattedTimer() }} Elapsed
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="completed-actions">
        <a class="btn-view-report" [routerLink]="['/candidate/interviews', sessionId(), 'report']">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-bar"></i> View My Report
        </a>
        <a class="btn-back-interviews" routerLink="/candidate/interviews">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> All Interviews
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <footer class="session-footer">
      <p>JobLens Kinetic &nbsp;•&nbsp; Secure Candidate Environment</p>
    </footer>
  </div>
}
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/interviews/candidate-interview-session.page.spec.ts`
```ts
import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { ActivatedRoute, convertToParamMap } from '@angular/router';
import { BehaviorSubject, Observable, of } from 'rxjs';

import {
  InterviewQuestionDto,
  InterviewSessionDto,
  ReportBrowserEventDto,
  SubmitAnswerDto
} from '../../../../core/models/interview.model';
import { InterviewsService } from '../../../interviews/interviews.service';
import { CandidateInterviewSessionPage } from './candidate-interview-session.page';

describe('CandidateInterviewSessionPage', () => {
  const paramMap$ = new BehaviorSubject(convertToParamMap({ sessionId: '7' }));

  const session: InterviewSessionDto = {
    id: 7,
    applicationId: 15,
    agentType: 'Mixed',
    interviewTitle: 'Frontend Technical Round',
    scheduledAt: '2026-04-11T10:00:00Z',
    startedAt: '2026-04-11T10:05:00Z',
    endedAt: null,
    overallScore: null,
    cheatingDetected: false,
    totalQuestions: 1,
    answeredQuestions: 0,
    status: 'Live',
    integritySessionId: null,
    interviewBackendSessionId: null,
    finalReport: null,
    aiFeedback: null,
    candidateName: 'Candidate One',
    jobTitle: 'Frontend Engineer',
    cheatingEventsCount: 0
  };

  const question: InterviewQuestionDto = {
    id: 11,
    sessionId: 7,
    questionText: 'How do you optimize Angular rendering?',
    orderIndex: 0,
    category: 'Performance',
    difficulty: 'Medium',
    maxDurationSeconds: 180,
    isAnswered: false,
    answer: null
  };

  let submitAnswerCalls: Array<{ payload: SubmitAnswerDto; audio?: File }>;
  let reportBrowserCalls: ReportBrowserEventDto[];
  let startCalls: number;

  let interviewsServiceMock: Partial<InterviewsService>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    submitAnswerCalls = [];
    reportBrowserCalls = [];
    startCalls = 0;

    interviewsServiceMock = {
      getSession: (): Observable<any> =>
        of({ success: true, message: 'ok', data: session }),
      getQuestions: (): Observable<any> =>
        of({ success: true, message: 'ok', data: [question] }),
      start: (): Observable<any> => {
        startCalls += 1;
        return of({ success: true, message: 'ok', data: session });
      },
      end: (): Observable<any> => of({ success: true, message: 'ok', data: session }),
      submitAnswer: (payload: SubmitAnswerDto, audioFile?: File): Observable<any> => {
        submitAnswerCalls.push({ payload, audio: audioFile });
        return of({ success: true, message: 'saved', data: null });
      },
      reportBrowserEvent: (payload: ReportBrowserEventDto): Observable<any> => {
        reportBrowserCalls.push(payload);
        return of({ success: true, message: 'synced', data: null });
      }
    };

    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [CandidateInterviewSessionPage],
      providers: [
        { provide: InterviewsService, useValue: interviewsServiceMock as unknown as InterviewsService },
        {
          provide: ActivatedRoute,
          useValue: {
            paramMap: paramMap$.asObservable()
          }
        }
      ]
    }).compileComponents();
  });

  it('loads session and questions on init', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateInterviewSessionPage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    expect(component.session()?.id).toBe(7);
    expect(component.questions().length).toBe(1);
    expect(component.selectedQuestion()?.id).toBe(11);
  });

  it('treats Live status as in-progress', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateInterviewSessionPage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    expect(component.interviewPhase()).toBe('in-progress');
  });

  it('requires microphone and camera before starting', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateInterviewSessionPage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    component.session.set({ ...session, status: 'Scheduled' });
    component.interviewPhase.set('pre-check');
    component.permissionsGranted.set({ mic: true, camera: false });

    component.enterInterview();

    expect(startCalls).toBe(0);
    expect(component.error()).toContain('microphone and camera');
  });

  it('submits answer draft for selected question', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateInterviewSessionPage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    component.onAnswerTextChanged('Use trackBy and OnPush with memoized selectors.');
    component.submitAnswer();

    expect(submitAnswerCalls.length).toBe(1);
    expect(submitAnswerCalls[0].payload.questionId).toBe(11);
    expect(submitAnswerCalls[0].payload.answerText).toContain('trackBy and OnPush');
  });

  it('reports browser events and resets counters', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateInterviewSessionPage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    component.browserCounters.set({
      tabSwitchCount: 1,
      focusLossCount: 2,
      copyPasteCount: 0,
      rightClickCount: 1
    });

    component.reportBrowserEvents();

    expect(reportBrowserCalls.length).toBe(1);
    expect(reportBrowserCalls[0].sessionId).toBe(7);
    expect(reportBrowserCalls[0].tabSwitchCount).toBe(1);
    expect(reportBrowserCalls[0].focusLossCount).toBe(2);
    expect(reportBrowserCalls[0].rightClickCount).toBe(1);
    expect(component.totalBrowserEvents()).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/interviews/candidate-interview-session.page.ts`
```ts
import { CommonModule, isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import {
  AfterViewChecked,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  HostListener,
  OnDestroy,
  PLATFORM_ID,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, Subscription, catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { TokenStoreService } from '../../../../core/auth/token-store.service';
import { InterviewsService } from '../../../interviews/interviews.service';
import { InterviewRealtimeService, VadState } from '../../../interviews/interview-realtime.service';
import { InterviewQuestionDto, InterviewSessionDto } from '../../../../core/models/interview.model';
import { environment } from '../../../../../environments/environment';

type BrowserCounterKey = 'tabSwitchCount' | 'focusLossCount' | 'copyPasteCount' | 'rightClickCount';

interface BrowserCounters {
  tabSwitchCount: number;
  focusLossCount: number;
  copyPasteCount: number;
  rightClickCount: number;
}

type TranscriptRole = 'candidate' | 'assistant' | 'system';
type InterviewPhase =
  | 'loading'
  | 'pre-check'
  | 'in-progress'
  | 'completing'
  | 'completed'
  | 'error';

interface TranscriptEntry {
  role: TranscriptRole;
  text: string;
  createdAtIso: string;
}

interface WaveformBar {
  dur: string;
  delay: string;
  h: number;
}

const EMPTY_BROWSER_COUNTERS: BrowserCounters = {
  tabSwitchCount: 0,
  focusLossCount: 0,
  copyPasteCount: 0,
  rightClickCount: 0,
};

const WAVEFORM_COUNT = 18;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-interview-session-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './candidate-interview-session.page.html',
  styleUrls: ['./candidate-interview-session.page.css'],
})
export class CandidateInterviewSessionPage implements OnDestroy, AfterViewChecked {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly interviewsService = inject(InterviewsService);
  private readonly realtime = inject(InterviewRealtimeService);
  private readonly tokenStore = inject(TokenStoreService);
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);

  @ViewChild('previewVideo') previewVideoRef!: ElementRef<HTMLVideoElement>;
  @ViewChild('arenaVideo') arenaVideoRef!: ElementRef<HTMLVideoElement>;
  @ViewChild('transcriptFeed') transcriptFeedRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement>;

  private readonly isBrowser = isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId);
  private browserMonitorsAttached = false;
  private timerInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private videoStreamInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private shouldScrollTranscript = false;

  private subs = new Subscription();

  // ─── Phase & UI State ───
  readonly interviewPhase = signal<InterviewPhase>('loading');
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly acting = signal(false);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly success = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly requestingPerms = signal(false);
  readonly permChecked = signal(false);
  readonly permissionsGranted = signal<{ camera: boolean; mic: boolean }>({
    camera: false,
    mic: false,
  });
  readonly cameraStream = signal<MediaStream | null>(null);
  readonly sessionTimerSeconds = signal(0);
  readonly confirmEndSessionOpen = signal(false);
  readonly leaveWarningOpen = signal(false);
  readonly leaveAttemptCount = signal(0);

  // ─── Session Data ───
  readonly sessionId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly session = signal<InterviewSessionDto | null>(null);
  readonly questions = signal<InterviewQuestionDto[]>([]);
  readonly browserCounters = signal<BrowserCounters>({ ...EMPTY_BROWSER_COUNTERS });
  readonly transcriptEntries = signal<TranscriptEntry[]>([]);
  readonly proctoringEvents = signal<string[]>([]);

  // ─── Realtime VAD Signals ───
  readonly vadState = signal<VadState>('idle');
  readonly volumeLevel = signal<number>(0);
  readonly cameraMonitoringActive = signal(false);

  readonly waveformBars: WaveformBar[] = Array.from({ length: WAVEFORM_COUNT }, (_, i) => ({
    dur: (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.8).toFixed(2),
    delay: (i * 0.05).toFixed(2),
    h: 8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 28),
  }));

  // ─── Computed Properties ───
  readonly answeredCount = computed(() => this.questions().filter((q) => q.isAnswered).length);
  readonly totalCount = computed(() => this.questions().length || 5);
  readonly hasRequiredPermissions = computed(
    () => this.permissionsGranted().mic && this.permissionsGranted().camera,
  );
  readonly hasTranscripts = computed(() => this.transcriptEntries().length > 0);
  readonly hasProctoringEvents = computed(() => this.proctoringEvents().length > 0);
  readonly totalBrowserEvents = computed(() => {
    const c = this.browserCounters();
    return c.tabSwitchCount + c.focusLossCount + c.copyPasteCount + c.rightClickCount;
  });
  readonly hasBrowserEvents = computed(() => this.totalBrowserEvents() > 0);
  readonly formattedTimer = computed(() => {
    const s = this.sessionTimerSeconds();
    const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
    const sec = s % 60;
    return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(sec).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  });

  readonly isRealtimeConnected = computed(() => this.vadState() !== 'idle');
  readonly isRealtimeConnecting = computed(() => this.vadState() === 'idle' && this.isInProgress());
  readonly liveCapturing = computed(
    () => this.vadState() === 'speaking' || this.vadState() === 'listening',
  );
  readonly audioPlaying = computed(() => this.vadState() === 'playing');
  readonly aiSpeechMode = computed<'idle' | 'audio' | 'fallback'>(() =>
    this.vadState() === 'playing' ? 'audio' : 'idle',
  );
  readonly aiConnected = computed(() => this.vadState() !== 'idle');
  readonly canUseRealtime = computed(() => this.isInProgress());

  constructor() {
    this.route.paramMap.subscribe((params) => {
      const rawId = Number(params.get('sessionId'));
      if (!Number.isFinite(rawId) || rawId <= 0) {
        this.interviewPhase.set('error');
        this.error.set('Invalid interview session identifier provided.');
        this.loading.set(false);
        return;
      }
      this.sessionId.set(rawId);
      this.load();
    });

    this.bindRealtimeEvents();
  }

  ngAfterViewChecked(): void {
    this.attachCameraToVideoElement();
    if (this.shouldScrollTranscript) {
      this.scrollTranscriptToBottom();
      this.shouldScrollTranscript = false;
    }
  }

  load(): void {
    const id = this.sessionId();
    if (!id) return;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      session: this.interviewsService.getSession(id).pipe(
        map((res) => res.data),
        catchError(() => of(null)),
      ),
      questions: this.interviewsService.getQuestions(id).pipe(
        map((res) => res.data ?? []),
        catchError(() => of([] as InterviewQuestionDto[])),
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ session, questions }) => {
          this.session.set(session);
          this.questions.set(questions);
          this.derivePhase(session);

          if (!session) {
            this.interviewPhase.set('error');
            this.error.set('Interview session details are unavailable.');
          }
        },
        error: () => {
          this.interviewPhase.set('error');
          this.error.set('Unable to load interview session details right now.');
        },
      });
  }

  private derivePhase(session: InterviewSessionDto | null): void {
    if (!session) {
      this.interviewPhase.set('error');
      return;
    }

    const status = (session.status ?? '').toLowerCase();
    if (status.includes('live') || status.includes('progress') || status.includes('started')) {
      this.interviewPhase.set('in-progress');
      this.startTimer();
      this.initRealtimeFlow(session.interviewSessionId || session.id || this.sessionId()!);
    } else if (status.includes('complet') || status.includes('ended')) {
      this.interviewPhase.set('completed');
      this.stopTimer();
    } else {
      this.interviewPhase.set('pre-check');
    }
  }

  isInProgress(): boolean {
    return this.interviewPhase() === 'in-progress' || this.interviewPhase() === 'completing';
  }

  async requestPermissions(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.isBrowser || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      this.error.set('Camera and microphone access are not supported in this browser.');
      return;
    }

    this.requestingPerms.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: true,
        video: { width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
      });

      this.cameraStream.set(stream);
      this.permissionsGranted.set({ camera: true, mic: true });
      this.success.set('Microphone and camera permissions granted.');
    } catch {
      this.permissionsGranted.set({ camera: false, mic: false });
      this.error.set('Camera and microphone permissions were denied.');
    } finally {
      this.permChecked.set(true);
      this.requestingPerms.set(false);
    }
  }

  enterInterview(): void {
    const id = this.sessionId();
    if (!id || this.acting()) return;

    this.acting.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.interviewsService
      .start(id)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.acting.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          if (res.data) {
            this.session.set(res.data);
          }
          this.interviewPhase.set('in-progress');
          this.startTimer();
          this.attachBrowserMonitors();
          this.initRealtimeFlow(id);
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(
            err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unable to start the interview session.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private async initRealtimeFlow(sessionId: number): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.realtime.connect(sessionId);
      await this.realtime.startAudioCapture();
      this.startVideoFrameStreaming();
      await this.realtime.requestOpeningPrompt();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Realtime interview connection failure:', err);
    }
  }

  private bindRealtimeEvents(): void {
    this.subs.add(this.realtime.vadState$.subscribe((state) => this.vadState.set(state)));
    this.subs.add(this.realtime.volumeLevel$.subscribe((vol) => this.volumeLevel.set(vol)));
    this.subs.add(
      this.realtime.audioProcessed$.subscribe((data) => {
        if (data.transcript) {
          this.pushTranscript('candidate', data.transcript);
        }
        if (data.reply) {
          this.pushTranscript('assistant', data.reply);
        }
        if (data.isComplete) {
          this.confirmEndSession();
        }
      }),
    );
    this.subs.add(
      this.realtime.proctoringEvent$.subscribe((event) => {
        this.proctoringEvents.update((evts) => [...evts, event.description]);
      }),
    );
  }

  connectRealtime(): void {
    const id = this.sessionId();
    if (id) void this.initRealtimeFlow(id);
  }

  endSession(): void {
    this.confirmEndSessionOpen.set(true);
  }

  confirmEndSession(): void {
    const id = this.sessionId();
    if (!id || this.acting()) return;

    this.confirmEndSessionOpen.set(false);
    this.interviewPhase.set('completing');
    this.acting.set(true);

    this.realtime.disconnect();
    this.stopVideoFrameStreaming();
    this.stopTimer();

    this.interviewsService
      .end(id)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.acting.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.session.set(res.data);
          this.interviewPhase.set('completed');
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.interviewPhase.set('in-progress');
          this.error.set(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unable to complete interview.');
        },
      });
  }

  handleRouteLeaveAttempt(): boolean | Observable<boolean> {
    if (!this.isInProgress()) return true;

    if (this.leaveAttemptCount() === 0) {
      this.leaveAttemptCount.set(1);
      this.leaveWarningOpen.set(true);
      return false;
    }

    this.confirmEndSession();
    return true;
  }

  dismissLeaveWarning(): void {
    this.leaveWarningOpen.set(false);
  }

  endSessionAfterLeaveWarning(): void {
    this.leaveWarningOpen.set(false);
    this.confirmEndSession();
  }

  @HostListener('window:beforeunload', ['$event'])
  handleBeforeUnload(event: BeforeUnloadEvent): void {
    if (!this.isInProgress()) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.returnValue = '';
  }

  private startTimer(): void {
    if (this.timerInterval) return;
    this.timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
      this.sessionTimerSeconds.update((s) => s + 1);
    }, 1000);
  }

  private stopTimer(): void {
    if (this.timerInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.timerInterval);
      this.timerInterval = null;
    }
  }

  private startVideoFrameStreaming(): void {
    if (!this.isBrowser || this.videoStreamInterval) return;
    this.cameraMonitoringActive.set(true);

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 320;
    canvas.height = 240;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    this.videoStreamInterval = setInterval(() => {
      const video = this.arenaVideoRef?.nativeElement ?? this.previewVideoRef?.nativeElement;
      if (!video || video.readyState < 2 || !ctx) return;

      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.45);
      const base64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1];
      if (base64) {
        void this.realtime.submitVideoFrame(base64);
      }
    }, 1500);
  }

  private stopVideoFrameStreaming(): void {
    this.cameraMonitoringActive.set(false);
    if (this.videoStreamInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.videoStreamInterval);
      this.videoStreamInterval = null;
    }
  }

  private pushTranscript(role: TranscriptRole, text: string): void {
    this.transcriptEntries.update((entries) => [
      ...entries,
      { role, text, createdAtIso: new Date().toISOString() },
    ]);
    this.shouldScrollTranscript = true;
  }

  private scrollTranscriptToBottom(): void {
    const el = this.transcriptFeedRef?.nativeElement;
    if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }

  private attachCameraToVideoElement(): void {
    const stream = this.cameraStream();
    if (!stream) return;

    if (
      this.previewVideoRef?.nativeElement &&
      this.previewVideoRef.nativeElement.srcObject !== stream
    ) {
      this.previewVideoRef.nativeElement.srcObject = stream;
    }

    if (
      this.arenaVideoRef?.nativeElement &&
      this.arenaVideoRef.nativeElement.srcObject !== stream
    ) {
      this.arenaVideoRef.nativeElement.srcObject = stream;
    }
  }

  private attachBrowserMonitors(): void {
    if (!this.isBrowser || this.browserMonitorsAttached) return;
    window.addEventListener('blur', this.handleBlur);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibility);
    this.browserMonitorsAttached = true;
  }

  private detachBrowserMonitors(): void {
    if (!this.isBrowser || !this.browserMonitorsAttached) return;
    window.removeEventListener('blur', this.handleBlur);
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibility);
    this.browserMonitorsAttached = false;
  }

  private readonly handleBlur = (): void => {
    this.bumpBrowserCounter('focusLossCount');
  };

  private readonly handleVisibility = (): void => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
      this.bumpBrowserCounter('tabSwitchCount');
    }
  };

  private bumpBrowserCounter(key: BrowserCounterKey): void {
    this.browserCounters.update((c) => ({ ...c, [key]: c[key] + 1 }));
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
    this.detachBrowserMonitors();
    this.stopTimer();
    this.stopVideoFrameStreaming();
    this.realtime.disconnect();

    const stream = this.cameraStream();
    if (stream) {
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    }
  }
}
```

```css
}

/* ── Session card ── */
.session-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  transition: box-shadow 0.18s, border-color 0.18s, transform 0.12s;
}

.session-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.07);
  border-color: #c8d6f7;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.card--live {
  border-color: #b5e6ca;
  background: #f5fdf8;
}

.card--completed {
  border-color: #d0e3ff;
  background: #f7faff;
}

/* Card top */
.card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.card-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.card-subtitle {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.card-badges {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Status badges */
.status {
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.status--scheduled {
  background: #eef3ff;
  color: #2b4e9f;
  border-color: #c8d6f7;
}

.status--live {
  background: #e4fcef;
  color: #0e7655;
  border-color: #b5e6ca;
  animation: status-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.status--completed {
  background: #def8e9;
  color: #1f6841;
  border-color: #b5e6ca;
}

.status--cancelled {
  background: #fff1df;
  color: #875120;
  border-color: #edd8bc;
}

@keyframes status-pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(14, 118, 85, 0.12);
  }
}

.badge-risk {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #fff3e0;
  color: #92400e;
  border: 1px solid #fde68a;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.5rem;
}

/* Card meta */
.card-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}

.meta-item {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.meta-item.muted {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.score-pill {
  background: #eef5ff;
  border: 1px solid #c8d6f7;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Card actions */
.card-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.btn-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.48rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.12s;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.btn-action:hover {
  opacity: 0.88;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-primary-action {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--jl-primary), #2b56c4);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.25);
}

.btn-report {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0e7549, #19b27a);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(25, 178, 122, 0.25);
}

.btn-secondary-action {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .stats-row {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .stat-chip {
    flex: none;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .card-top {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .card-badges {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .filter-bar {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
}
```

```html
<section class="interviews-page">
  <!-- Header -->
  <header class="page-header">
    <div class="header-text">
      <h1>My Interviews</h1>
      <p>Track your AI interview sessions — view upcoming, enter active sessions, and access reports.</p>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="btn-refresh" (click)="load()" [disabled]="loading()">
      @if (loading()) {
        <span class="btn-spinner"></span>
      } @else {
        <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i>
      }
      {{ loading() ? 'Loading...' : 'Refresh' }}
    </button>
  </header>

  <!-- Error -->
  @if (error()) {
    <div class="alert-error">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> {{ error() }}
    </div>
  }

  <!-- Stats -->
  <div class="stats-row">
    <div class="stat-chip">
      <span class="stat-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-list"></i></span>
      <div>
        <span class="stat-label">Total</span>
        <strong class="stat-value">{{ totalSessions() }}</strong>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-chip">
      <span class="stat-icon"><i class="fa-regular fa-calendar-days"></i></span>
      <div>
        <span class="stat-label">Scheduled</span>
        <strong class="stat-value">{{ scheduledSessions() }}</strong>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-chip accent">
      <span class="stat-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i></span>
      <div>
        <span class="stat-label">Completed</span>
        <strong class="stat-value">{{ completedSessions() }}</strong>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Filter bar -->
  <div class="filter-bar">
    <div class="filter-group">
      <label class="filter-label" for="status-filter">Status</label>
      <select
        id="status-filter"
        class="filter-select"
        #statusSelect
        [value]="statusFilter()"
        (change)="onStatusFilterChanged(statusSelect.value)"
        [disabled]="loading()"
      >
        <option value="">All statuses</option>
        @for (status of statusOptions(); track status) {
          <option [value]="status">{{ formatStatus(status) }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn-apply" (click)="applyFilter()" [disabled]="loading()">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-filter"></i> Apply
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-clear" (click)="clearFilter()" [disabled]="loading()">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i> Clear
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Sessions list -->
  <div class="sessions-container">
    <div class="list-header">
      <h2>Interview Sessions</h2>
      <span class="list-count">{{ interviews().length }} sessions</span>
    </div>

    @if (loading() && interviews().length === 0) {
      <div class="skeleton-list">
        @for (i of [1, 2, 3]; track i) {
          <div class="skeleton-card">
            <div class="sk-line wide"></div>
            <div class="sk-line med"></div>
            <div class="sk-line short"></div>
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    } @else if (interviews().length === 0) {
      <div class="empty-state">
        <span class="empty-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-microphone-lines"></i></span>
        <h3>No interviews yet</h3>
        <p>Your AI interview sessions will appear here once a recruiter schedules them for your applications.</p>
      </div>
    } @else {
      <div class="sessions-list">
        @for (session of interviews(); track session.id) {
          <article class="session-card" [class.card--live]="isLive(session)" [class.card--completed]="isCompleted(session)">
            <!-- Card top: title + status -->
            <div class="card-top">
              <div class="card-info">
                <h3 class="card-title">{{ session.interviewTitle || session.jobTitle }}</h3>
                <p class="card-subtitle">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase" style="opacity:.5;margin-right:.3rem"></i>
                  {{ session.jobTitle }}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div class="card-badges">
                <span [class]="getStatusClass(session.status)">
                  @if (isLive(session)) {
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-circle" style="color:#ba1a1a;font-size:.55rem"></i>
                  }
                  {{ formatStatus(session.status) }}
                </span>
                @if (session.cheatingDetected) {
                  <span class="badge-risk">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> Integrity flag
                  </span>
                }
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Card meta -->
            <div class="card-meta">
              @if (session.scheduledAt) {
                <span class="meta-item">
                  <i class="fa-regular fa-calendar-days"></i>
                  {{ session.scheduledAt | date: 'MMM d, y · h:mm a' }}
                </span>
              } @else {
                <span class="meta-item muted">
                  <i class="fa-regular fa-calendar-xmark"></i> Schedule pending
                </span>
              }
              @if (session.overallScore !== null && session.overallScore !== undefined) {
                <span class="meta-item score-pill">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-trophy"></i> Score: {{ session.overallScore | number: '1.0-1' }}
                </span>
              }
              <span class="meta-item muted">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i> {{ session.candidateName }}
              </span>
            </div>

            <!-- Card actions -->
            <div class="card-actions">
              @if (isLive(session) || isScheduled(session)) {
                <a
                  class="btn-action btn-primary-action"
                  [routerLink]="['/candidate/interviews', session.id]"
                >
                  @if (isLive(session)) {
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i> Resume Interview
                  } @else {
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-door-open"></i> Enter Interview
                  }
                </a>
              }
              @if (canViewReport(session)) {
                <a
                  class="btn-action btn-report"
                  [routerLink]="['/candidate/interviews', session.id, 'report']"
                >
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-bar"></i> View Report
                </a>
              }
              @if (!isLive(session) && !isScheduled(session) && !canViewReport(session)) {
                <a
                  class="btn-action btn-secondary-action"
                  [routerLink]="['/candidate/interviews', session.id]"
                >
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i> View Details
                </a>
              }
            </div>
          </article>
        }
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</section>
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/interviews/candidate-interviews.page.ts`
```ts
import { CommonModule, DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { InterviewsService } from '../../../interviews/interviews.service';
import { InterviewSessionListDto } from '../../../../core/models/interview.model';

const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  'Draft',
  'Scheduled',
  'Live',
  'InProgress',
  'Completed',
  'Abandoned',
  'ReviewRequired',
  'Cancelled'
];

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-interviews-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, DatePipe, DecimalPipe],
  templateUrl: './candidate-interviews.page.html',
  styleUrls: ['./candidate-interviews.page.css']
})
export class CandidateInterviewsPage {
  private readonly interviewsService = inject(InterviewsService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly statusOptions = signal<string[]>([...STATUS_OPTIONS]);
  readonly statusFilter = signal('');
  readonly interviews = signal<InterviewSessionListDto[]>([]);

  readonly totalSessions = computed(() => this.interviews().length);
  readonly scheduledSessions = computed(
    () =>
      this.interviews().filter((i) => {
        const s = this.normalizeStatus(i.status);
        return s.includes('scheduled') || s.includes('draft');
      }).length
  );
  readonly completedSessions = computed(
    () =>
      this.interviews().filter((i) => this.normalizeStatus(i.status).includes('complet')).length
  );

  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.interviewsService
      .getCandidateInterviews({
        pageNumber: 1,
        pageSize: 100,
        sortBy: 'scheduledAt',
        status: this.statusFilter().trim() || undefined
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => this.interviews.set(res.data?.items ?? []),
        error: (err: unknown) =>
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to load interview sessions right now.'))
      });
  }

  onStatusFilterChanged(value: string): void {
    this.statusFilter.set(value);
  }

  applyFilter(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  clearFilter(): void {
    this.statusFilter.set('');
    this.load();
  }

  isScheduled(session: InterviewSessionListDto): boolean {
    const s = this.normalizeStatus(session.status);
    return s.includes('scheduled') || s.includes('draft');
  }

  isLive(session: InterviewSessionListDto): boolean {
    const s = this.normalizeStatus(session.status);
    return s.includes('progress') || s.includes('live') || s.includes('started');
  }

  isCompleted(session: InterviewSessionListDto): boolean {
    return this.normalizeStatus(session.status).includes('complet');
  }

  canViewReport(session: InterviewSessionListDto): boolean {
    return (
      this.isCompleted(session) &&
      session.overallScore !== null &&
      session.overallScore !== undefined
    );
  }

  formatStatus(status: string): string {
    return status.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1 $2').replace(/_/g, ' ').trim();
  }

  getStatusClass(status: string): string {
    const s = this.normalizeStatus(status);
    if (s.includes('complet')) return 'status status--completed';
    if (s.includes('progress') || s.includes('live') || s.includes('started'))
      return 'status status--live';
    if (s.includes('cancel') || s.includes('abandon')) return 'status status--cancelled';
    return 'status status--scheduled';
  }

  private normalizeStatus(status: string): string {
    return (status ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  private mapError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    if (err instanceof Error && err.message) return err.message;
    return fallback;
  }
}
```

```css
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.optional {
  font-weight: 400;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.cover-textarea {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  resize: vertical;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
  min-height: 100px;
}

.cover-textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.cover-textarea:disabled {
  opacity: 0.65;
}

/* Apply button */
.btn-apply-now {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--jl-primary), #2b56c4);
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.2rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.3);
  transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.12s;
}

.btn-apply-now:hover:not(:disabled) {
  opacity: 0.88;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-apply-now:disabled {
  background: #e8edf7;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  box-shadow: none;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.btn-spinner {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  border-top-color: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.75s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .detail-sidebar {
    position: static;
  }

  .hero-top {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}
```
