```html
<section class="job-detail-page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <a class="back-link" routerLink="/candidate/jobs">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Back to Jobs
    </a>
    <button type="button" class="btn-refresh" (click)="load()" [disabled]="loading() || applying()">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> {{ loading() ? 'Loading…' : 'Refresh' }}
    </button>
  </header>

  @if (error()) {
    <div class="alert alert-error">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> {{ error() }}
    </div>
  }
  @if (success()) {
    <div class="alert alert-success">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> {{ success() }}
    </div>
  }

  @if (loading() && !job()) {
    <div class="job-skeleton">
      <div class="sk-hero">
        <div class="sk-line xl"></div>
        <div class="sk-line wide"></div>
        <div class="sk-pill"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sk-body">
        <div class="sk-card tall"></div>
        <div class="sk-card short"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  }

  @if (job(); as j) {
    <div class="job-hero">
      <div class="hero-content">
        <div class="hero-top">
          <div>
            <h1 class="hero-title">{{ j.title }}</h1>
            <p class="hero-company">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-building" style="opacity:.6;margin-right:.3rem"></i>
              {{ j.companyName || 'Company' }} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {{ j.location || 'Location TBD' }}
            </p>
          </div>
          @if (hasApplied()) {
            <span class="applied-badge">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Applied
            </span>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="hero-chips">
          <span class="chip chip--type">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i> {{ j.employmentType }}
          </span>
          @if (j.salaryRange) {
            <span class="chip chip--salary">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-coins"></i> {{ j.salaryRange }}
            </span>
          }
          @if (j.experienceLevel) {
            <span class="chip">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-user-graduate"></i> {{ j.experienceLevel }}
            </span>
          }
          <span class="chip">
            <i class="fa-regular fa-calendar-days"></i> Posted {{ j.postedAt | date: 'MMM d, y' }}
          </span>
          @if (j.expiresAt) {
            <span class="chip chip--deadline">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-hourglass-half"></i> Closes {{ j.expiresAt | date: 'MMM d, y' }}
            </span>
          }
          <span class="chip">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-users"></i> {{ j.applicationCount }} applicants
          </span>
          <span class="chip chip--source">{{ j.source }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="detail-grid">
      <div class="detail-main">
        @if (j.description) {
          <div class="content-section">
            <h2 class="section-title">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines"></i> Job Description
            </h2>
            <p class="multiline-text">{{ j.description }}</p>
          </div>
        }
        @if (j.responsibilities) {
          <div class="content-section">
            <h2 class="section-title">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-bullseye"></i> Responsibilities
            </h2>
            <p class="multiline-text">{{ j.responsibilities }}</p>
          </div>
        }
        @if (j.requirements) {
          <div class="content-section">
            <h2 class="section-title">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check"></i> Requirements
            </h2>
            <p class="multiline-text">{{ j.requirements }}</p>
          </div>
        }
      </div>

      <aside class="detail-sidebar">
        <div class="sidebar-card">
          <h3 class="sidebar-title">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-code" style="color:#4059aa;margin-right:.4rem"></i> Required Skills
          </h3>
          @if (j.requiredSkills.length === 0) {
            <p class="sidebar-empty">No required skills listed.</p>
          } @else {
            <div class="skills-grid">
              @for (skill of j.requiredSkills; track skill) {
                <span class="skill-chip">{{ skill }}</span>
              }
            </div>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="sidebar-card apply-card">
          @if (j.source === 'Scraped') {
            <div class="external-notice">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-globe external-icon"></i>
              <p>This role was sourced externally. Apply directly on the company's website.</p>
            </div>

            @if (j.externalUrl) {
              <a class="btn-apply-external" [href]="j.externalUrl" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i> Apply on Source Website
              </a>
            } @else {
              <p class="sidebar-empty">Application link is not available for this external listing yet.</p>
            }
          } @else {
            <h3 class="sidebar-title">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane" style="color:#4059aa;margin-right:.4rem"></i> Apply to this Role
            </h3>

            @if (!defaultResumeId()) {
              <div class="resume-warning">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
                No resume found. Please upload one first.
                <a routerLink="/candidate/profile" class="resume-link">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i> Upload Resume
                </a>
              </div>
            }

            <div class="cover-field">
              <label class="cover-label" for="cover-letter-input">
                Cover Letter <span class="optional">(optional)</span>
              </label>
              <textarea
                id="cover-letter-input"
                class="cover-textarea"
                #coverInput
                rows="4"
                [value]="coverLetter()"
                (input)="onCoverLetterChanged(coverInput.value)"
                [disabled]="applying() || hasApplied()"
                placeholder="Add a short note to support your application…"
              ></textarea>
            </div>

            <button type="button" class="btn-apply-now" (click)="applyNow()" [disabled]="hasApplied() || applying() || !defaultResumeId()">
              @if (applying()) {
                <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Submitting…
              } @else if (hasApplied()) {
                <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Already Applied
              } @else {
                <i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane"></i> Apply Now
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  }
</section>
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/jobs/candidate-job-detail.page.ts`
```ts
import { CommonModule, DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { JobDto } from '../../../../core/models/job.model';
import { ApplicationsService } from '../../../applications/applications.service';
import { JobsService } from '../../../jobs/jobs.service';
import { ResumeService } from '../../../resumes/resume.service';
import { ResumeDto } from '../../../../core/models/resume.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-job-detail-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, DatePipe],
  templateUrl: './candidate-job-detail.page.html',
  styleUrl: './candidate-job-detail.page.css'
})
export class CandidateJobDetailPage {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly jobsService = inject(JobsService);
  private readonly applicationsService = inject(ApplicationsService);
  private readonly resumeService = inject(ResumeService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly applying = signal(false);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly success = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly jobId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly job = signal<JobDto | null>(null);
  readonly hasApplied = signal(false);
  readonly defaultResumeId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly coverLetter = signal('');

  constructor() {
    this.route.paramMap.subscribe((params) => {
      const rawId = Number(params.get('jobId'));
      if (!Number.isFinite(rawId) || rawId <= 0) {
        this.loading.set(false);
        this.error.set('Invalid job identifier provided.');
        return;
      }

      this.jobId.set(rawId);
      this.load();
    });
  }

  load(): void {
    const id = this.jobId();
    if (!id) {
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      job: this.jobsService.getById(id).pipe(
        map((res) => res.data),
        catchError(() => of(null))
      ),
      hasApplied: this.applicationsService.checkIfApplied(id).pipe(
        map((res) => !!res.data?.hasApplied),
        catchError(() => of(false))
      ),
      resumes: this.resumeService.getMyResumes().pipe(
        map((res) => res.data ?? []),
        catchError(() => of([] as ResumeDto[]))
      )
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ job, hasApplied, resumes }) => {
          this.job.set(job);
          this.hasApplied.set(hasApplied);

          const preferredResume = resumes.find((item) => item.isDefault) ?? resumes[0] ?? null;
          this.defaultResumeId.set(preferredResume?.id ?? null);

          if (!job) {
            this.error.set('Job details are unavailable.');
          }
        },
        error: () => {
          this.error.set('Unable to load this job right now.');
        }
      });
  }

  onCoverLetterChanged(value: string): void {
    this.coverLetter.set(value);
  }

  applyNow(): void {
    const id = this.jobId();
    if (!id || this.applying() || this.hasApplied()) {
      return;
    }

    this.applying.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    const resumeId = this.defaultResumeId();
    if (!resumeId) {
      this.applying.set(false);
      this.error.set('Please upload a resume before applying to jobs.');
      return;
    }

    this.applicationsService
      .apply({
        jobId: id,
        resumeId,
        coverLetter: this.coverLetter().trim() || undefined
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.applying.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Application submitted successfully.');
          this.hasApplied.set(true);
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to submit your application right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  private mapError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    if (err instanceof Error && err.message) {
      return err.message;
    }

    return fallback;
  }
}
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/jobs/candidate-jobs.page.css`
```css
.candidate-jobs-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

/* ── Header ── */
.page-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.page-header h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.page-header p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

/* ── Shared buttons ── */
.refresh {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
}

.refresh:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
  background: #f0f4ff;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.refresh:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: wait;
}

/* ── Alerts ── */
.banner {
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.banner.error {
  background: #fff3f2;
  border: 1px solid #f8d3d0;
  color: var(--jl-danger);
}

.banner.success {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  border: 1px solid #b5e6ca;
  color: #1f6841;
}

/* ── Filter panel ── */
.panel {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem;
}

.filters {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr auto;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  align-items: end;
}

.filter-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.filter-label {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.filter-input,
.filter-select {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.filter-input:focus,
.filter-select:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.filter-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.btn-apply {
  background: var(--jl-primary);
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.btn-apply:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: wait;
}

.btn-clear {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ── Jobs section ── */
.jobs-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.section-head h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.section-meta {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

/* ── Jobs grid ── */
.jobs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

/* ── Job card ── */
.job-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.12s;
}

.job-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.08);
  border-color: #c8d6f7;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Applied state */
.job-card.card--applied {
  border-color: #b5e6ca;
  background: #f7fdf9;
}

.job-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.job-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.job-company {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.source-chip {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Meta chips */
.meta-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.meta-chip {
  background: #eef3ff;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
}

/* Skills */
.skills-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.skill-tag {
  background: #f5f8ff;
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
}

.skill-empty {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Card footer */
.card-footer {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 0.25rem;
}

.btn-apply-job {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--jl-primary), #2b56c4);
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.12s;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.22);
}

.btn-apply-job:hover:not(:disabled) {
  opacity: 0.88;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-apply-job:disabled {
  background: #e8edf7;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  box-shadow: none;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.btn-view {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  transition: border-color 0.12s;
}

.btn-view:hover {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

/* ── Skeleton ── */
.jobs-skeleton {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.sk-job {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.sk-line {
  height: 13px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #e8edf7;
}

.sk-line.wide { width: 70%; }
.sk-line.med { width: 50%; }
.sk-line.short { width: 35%; }

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}

/* ── Empty state ── */
.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 3rem 1.5rem;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.empty-state p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

/* ── Pagination ── */
.pagination {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding-top: 0.85rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
}

.pagination-info {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.btn-page {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.12s, color 0.12s;
}

.btn-page:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.btn-page:disabled {
  opacity: 0.4;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .filters {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .filters {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .jobs-grid,
  .jobs-skeleton {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .filters {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
```

```html
<section class="candidate-jobs-page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1>Discover Careers</h1>
      <p>Browse active opportunities tailored to your profile and skills.</p>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="refresh" (click)="load()" [disabled]="loading()">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> {{ loading() ? 'Loading…' : 'Refresh' }}
    </button>
  </header>

  @if (error()) {
    <p class="banner error"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> {{ error() }}</p>
  }
  @if (success()) {
    <p class="banner success"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> {{ success() }}</p>
  }

  <div class="panel filters">
    <div class="filter-field">
      <label class="filter-label" for="job-keyword">Keyword</label>
      <input id="job-keyword" class="filter-input" type="text" #keywordInput
        [value]="keyword()" (input)="onKeywordChanged(keywordInput.value)"
        placeholder="Role, skill, or company" />
    </div>
    <div class="filter-field">
      <label class="filter-label" for="job-location">Location</label>
      <input id="job-location" class="filter-input" type="text" #locationInput
        [value]="location()" (input)="onLocationChanged(locationInput.value)"
        placeholder="Remote, Cairo, Dubai…" />
    </div>
    <div class="filter-field">
      <label class="filter-label" for="job-employment-type">Type</label>
      <select id="job-employment-type" class="filter-select" #employmentTypeSelect
        [value]="employmentType()" (change)="onEmploymentTypeChanged(employmentTypeSelect.value)">
        <option value="">All types</option>
        @for (type of employmentTypes(); track type) { <option [value]="type">{{ type }}</option> }
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-field">
      <label class="filter-label" for="job-source">Source</label>
      <select id="job-source" class="filter-select" #sourceSelect
        [value]="source()" (change)="onSourceChanged(sourceSelect.value)">
        <option value="">All sources</option>
        @for (opt of sources(); track opt) { <option [value]="opt">{{ opt }}</option> }
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn-apply" (click)="applyFilters()" [disabled]="loading()">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i> Search
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-clear" (click)="clearFilters()" [disabled]="loading()">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i> Clear
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="panel jobs-panel">
    <div class="section-head">
      <h2>Open Positions</h2>
      <span class="section-meta">
        {{ totalCount() }} results · Page {{ pageNumber() }} of {{ totalPages() }}
      </span>
    </div>

    @if (loading() && jobs().length === 0) {
      <div class="jobs-skeleton">
        @for (i of [1,2,3,4,5,6]; track i) {
          <div class="sk-job">
            <div class="sk-line wide"></div>
            <div class="sk-line med"></div>
            <div class="sk-line short"></div>
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    } @else if (jobs().length === 0) {
      <div class="empty-state">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass" style="font-size:2.5rem;opacity:.3"></i>
        <p>No active jobs matched your current filters. Try broadening your search.</p>
      </div>
    } @else {
      <div class="jobs-grid">
        @for (job of jobs(); track job.id) {
          <article class="job-card" [class.card--applied]="isApplied(job.id)">
            <div class="job-card-top">
              <div>
                <h3 class="job-title">{{ job.title }}</h3>
                <p class="job-company">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-building" style="opacity:.5;margin-right:.25rem"></i>
                  {{ job.companyName || 'Company' }} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {{ job.location || 'Location TBD' }}
                </p>
              </div>
              <span class="source-chip">{{ job.source }}</span>
            </div>

            <div class="meta-chips">
              <span class="meta-chip">{{ job.employmentType }}</span>
              @if (job.salaryRange) {
                <span class="meta-chip">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-coins"></i> {{ job.salaryRange }}
                </span>
              }
              <span class="meta-chip">
                <i class="fa-regular fa-calendar-days"></i> {{ job.postedAt | date: 'MMM d, y' }}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div class="skills-row">
              @if (job.topSkills.length === 0) {
                <span class="skill-empty">No skills tagged</span>
              } @else {
                @for (skill of job.topSkills; track skill) {
                  <span class="skill-tag">{{ skill }}</span>
                }
              }
            </div>

            <div class="card-footer">
              <button type="button" class="btn-apply-job" (click)="onPrimaryAction(job)" [disabled]="shouldDisableApply(job)">
                @if (isApplying(job.id)) {
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i> Applying…
                } @else {
                  @if (isExternalJob(job)) {
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i> {{ getApplyLabel(job) }}
                  } @else {
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane"></i> {{ getApplyLabel(job) }}
                  }
                }
              </button>
              <a class="btn-view" [routerLink]="['/candidate/jobs', job.id]">
                Details <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
              </a>
            </div>
          </article>
        }
      </div>

      @if (totalCount() > 0) {
        <div class="pagination">
          <button type="button" class="btn-page" (click)="goToPreviousPage()" [disabled]="loading() || !hasPreviousPage()">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Prev
          </button>
          <span class="pagination-info">Page {{ pageNumber() }} of {{ totalPages() }}</span>
          <button type="button" class="btn-page" (click)="goToNextPage()" [disabled]="loading() || !hasNextPage()">
            Next <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
          </button>
        </div>
      }
    }
  </div>
</section>
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/jobs/candidate-jobs.page.ts`
```ts
import { CommonModule, DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { ActivatedRoute, ParamMap, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { ApplicationsService } from '../../../applications/applications.service';
import { JobsService } from '../../../jobs/jobs.service';
import { ResumeService } from '../../../resumes/resume.service';
import { EmploymentType, JobListDto, JobSource } from '../../../../core/models/job.model';
import { ResumeDto } from '../../../../core/models/resume.model';

const EMPLOYMENT_TYPES: EmploymentType[] = [
  'FullTime',
  'PartTime',
  'Contract',
  'Internship',
  'Freelance',
  'Remote'
];

const SOURCES: JobSource[] = ['Internal', 'Scraped'];
const PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS = [12, 24, 48] as const;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-jobs-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, DatePipe],
  templateUrl: './candidate-jobs.page.html',
  styleUrl: './candidate-jobs.page.css'
})
export class CandidateJobsPage {
  private readonly jobsService = inject(JobsService);
  private readonly applicationsService = inject(ApplicationsService);
  private readonly resumeService = inject(ResumeService);
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly success = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly jobs = signal<JobListDto[]>([]);
  readonly totalCount = signal(0);
  readonly totalPages = signal(1);
  readonly hasPreviousPage = signal(false);
  readonly hasNextPage = signal(false);

  readonly pageNumber = signal(1);
  readonly pageSize = signal<number>(PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS[0]);

  readonly appliedJobIds = signal<number[]>([]);
  readonly defaultResumeId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly applying = signal<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  readonly employmentTypes = signal<EmploymentType[]>([...EMPLOYMENT_TYPES]);
  readonly sources = signal<JobSource[]>([...SOURCES]);
  readonly pageSizeOptions = signal<number[]>([...PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS]);

  readonly keyword = signal('');
  readonly location = signal('');
  readonly employmentType = signal<EmploymentType | ''>('');
  readonly source = signal<JobSource | ''>('');

  constructor() {
    this.route.queryParamMap.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed()).subscribe((params) => {
      this.hydrateFromQuery(params);
      this.load();
    });
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      jobs: this.jobsService
        .search({
          pageNumber: this.pageNumber(),
          pageSize: this.pageSize(),
          sortBy: 'postedAt',
          sortDescending: true,
          isActive: true,
          keyword: this.keyword().trim() || undefined,
          location: this.location().trim() || undefined,
          employmentType: this.employmentType() || undefined,
          source: this.source() || undefined
        })
        .pipe(
          map((res) => {
            const data = res.data;

            return {
              items: data?.items ?? [],
              totalCount: data?.totalCount ?? 0,
              pageNumber: data?.pageNumber ?? this.pageNumber(),
              pageSize: data?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize(),
              totalPages: data?.totalPages ?? 1,
              hasPreviousPage: data?.hasPreviousPage ?? false,
              hasNextPage: data?.hasNextPage ?? false
            };
          }),
          catchError(() =>
            of({
              items: [] as JobListDto[],
              totalCount: 0,
              pageNumber: this.pageNumber(),
              pageSize: this.pageSize(),
              totalPages: 1,
              hasPreviousPage: false,
              hasNextPage: false
            })
          )
        ),
      appliedJobIds: this.applicationsService
        .getMyApplications({
          pageNumber: 1,
          pageSize: 200,
          sortBy: 'appliedAt',
          sortDescending: true
        })
        .pipe(
          map((res) => {
            const ids = (res.data?.items ?? []).map((item) => item.jobId);
            return [...new Set(ids)];
          }),
          catchError(() => of([] as number[]))
        ),
      resumes: this.resumeService
        .getMyResumes()
        .pipe(
          map((res) => res.data ?? []),
          catchError(() => of([] as ResumeDto[]))
        )
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ jobs, appliedJobIds, resumes }) => {
          this.jobs.set(jobs.items);
          this.totalCount.set(jobs.totalCount);
          this.totalPages.set(Math.max(1, jobs.totalPages));
          this.hasPreviousPage.set(jobs.hasPreviousPage);
          this.hasNextPage.set(jobs.hasNextPage);

          if (jobs.pageNumber !== this.pageNumber()) {
            this.pageNumber.set(jobs.pageNumber);
          }
          if (jobs.pageSize !== this.pageSize()) {
            this.pageSize.set(jobs.pageSize);
          }

          this.appliedJobIds.set(appliedJobIds);

          const preferredResume = resumes.find((item) => item.isDefault) ?? resumes[0] ?? null;
          this.defaultResumeId.set(preferredResume?.id ?? null);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.error.set('Unable to load job listings right now.');
        }
      });
  }

  onKeywordChanged(value: string): void {
    this.keyword.set(value);
  }

  onLocationChanged(value: string): void {
    this.location.set(value);
  }

  onEmploymentTypeChanged(value: string): void {
    this.employmentType.set(this.toEmploymentType(value));
  }

  onSourceChanged(value: string): void {
    this.source.set(this.toSource(value));
  }

  applyFilters(): void {
    this.pageNumber.set(1);
    this.updateQueryParams();
  }

  clearFilters(): void {
    this.keyword.set('');
    this.location.set('');
    this.employmentType.set('');
    this.source.set('');
    this.pageNumber.set(1);
    this.updateQueryParams();
  }

  onPageSizeChanged(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    const nextPageSize = PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS.includes(parsed as (typeof PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS)[number])
      ? parsed
      : PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS[0];

    this.pageSize.set(nextPageSize);
    this.pageNumber.set(1);
    this.updateQueryParams();
  }

  goToPreviousPage(): void {
    if (this.loading() || !this.hasPreviousPage()) {
      return;
    }

    this.pageNumber.set(Math.max(1, this.pageNumber() - 1));
    this.updateQueryParams();
  }

  goToNextPage(): void {
    if (this.loading() || !this.hasNextPage()) {
      return;
    }

    this.pageNumber.set(this.pageNumber() + 1);
    this.updateQueryParams();
  }

  onPrimaryAction(job: JobListDto): void {
    if (this.isExternalJob(job)) {
      const externalUrl = job.externalUrl?.trim();
      if (!externalUrl) {
        this.error.set('This external listing does not include an application link yet.');
        return;
      }

      window.open(externalUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
      return;
    }

    this.applyToJob(job.id);
  }

  applyToJob(jobId: number): void {
    if (this.isApplied(jobId) || this.isApplying(jobId)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setApplying(jobId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    const resumeId = this.defaultResumeId();
    if (!resumeId) {
      this.setApplying(jobId, false);
      this.error.set('Please upload a resume before applying to jobs.');
      return;
    }

    this.applicationsService
      .apply({ jobId, resumeId })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setApplying(jobId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Application submitted successfully.');
          this.appliedJobIds.set([...new Set([...this.appliedJobIds(), jobId])]);
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to apply to this job right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  isApplying(jobId: number): boolean {
    return !!this.applying()[jobId];
  }

  isApplied(jobId: number): boolean {
    return this.appliedJobIds().includes(jobId);
  }

  isExternalJob(job: JobListDto): boolean {
    return job.source === 'Scraped';
  }

  shouldDisableApply(job: JobListDto): boolean {
    if (this.isExternalJob(job)) {
      return !job.externalUrl;
    }

    return this.isApplied(job.id) || this.isApplying(job.id);
  }

  getApplyLabel(job: JobListDto): string {
    if (this.isExternalJob(job)) {
      return job.externalUrl ? 'Apply externally' : 'External listing';
    }
    if (this.isApplied(job.id)) {
      return 'Applied';
    }
    if (this.isApplying(job.id)) {
      return 'Applying...';
    }
    return 'Apply now';
  }

  private setApplying(jobId: number, value: boolean): void {
    const next = { ...this.applying() };
    if (value) {
      next[jobId] = true;
    } else {
      delete next[jobId];
    }
    this.applying.set(next);
  }

  private toEmploymentType(value: string): EmploymentType | '' {
    if (EMPLOYMENT_TYPES.includes(value as EmploymentType)) {
      return value as EmploymentType;
    }
    return '';
  }

  private toSource(value: string): JobSource | '' {
    if (SOURCES.includes(value as JobSource)) {
      return value as JobSource;
    }
    return '';
  }

  private mapError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    if (err instanceof Error && err.message) {
      return err.message;
    }

    return fallback;
  }

  private hydrateFromQuery(params: ParamMap): void {
    this.keyword.set(params.get('keyword') ?? '');
    this.location.set(params.get('location') ?? '');
    this.employmentType.set(this.toEmploymentType(params.get('employmentType') ?? ''));
    this.source.set(this.toSource(params.get('source') ?? ''));

    this.pageNumber.set(this.parsePositiveInt(params.get('page'), 1));
    this.pageSize.set(this.parsePageSize(params.get('pageSize')));
  }

  private updateQueryParams(): void {
    this.router.navigate([], {
      relativeTo: this.route,
      queryParams: {
        keyword: this.keyword().trim() || undefined,
        location: this.location().trim() || undefined,
        employmentType: this.employmentType() || undefined,
        source: this.source() || undefined,
        page: this.pageNumber() > 1 ? this.pageNumber() : undefined,
        pageSize: this.pageSize() !== PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS[0] ? this.pageSize() : undefined
      },
      replaceUrl: true
    });
  }

  private parsePositiveInt(value: string | null, fallback: number): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback;
  }

  private parsePageSize(value: string | null): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS.includes(parsed as (typeof PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS)[number])
      ? parsed
      : PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS[0];
  }
}
```
