### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/profile/candidate-profile.page.css`
```css
.candidate-profile-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

/* ── Header ── */
.page-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.page-header h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.page-header p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

/* ── Refresh ── */
.refresh {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.refresh:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.refresh:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: wait;
}

/* ── Alerts ── */
.banner {
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.banner.error {
  background: #fff3f2;
  border: 1px solid #f8d3d0;
  color: var(--jl-danger);
}

.banner.success {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  border: 1px solid #b5e6ca;
  color: #1f6841;
}

/* ── Layout ── */
.layout-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  align-items: start;
}

/* ── Panel ── */
.panel {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.1rem;
}

.panel h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.section-head h2,
.section-head h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.section-head span {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
}

/* ── Profile form ── */
.profile-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.9rem;
}

.profile-form label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.profile-form input,
.profile-form textarea {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  padding: 0.62rem 0.9rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.profile-form input:focus,
.profile-form textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.profile-form textarea {
  resize: vertical;
  min-height: 90px;
}

/* Two-column fields */
.form-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

/* ── Shared buttons ── */
button {
  border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--jl-primary);
  color: #fff;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.58rem 1.1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.12s;
}

button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  opacity: 0.88;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
}

.secondary {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  border-color: var(--jl-border);
}

.secondary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.danger {
  background: var(--jl-danger);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--jl-danger);
}

.danger:hover:not(:disabled) {
  opacity: 0.85;
}

/* ── Profile image ── */
.profile-image {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 180px;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 3px solid var(--jl-border);
  display: block;
}

.inline-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

/* ── Skills ── */
.skill-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.skill-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.skill-card:hover {
  border-color: #c8d6f7;
}

.skill-card strong {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  display: block;
}

.skill-card small {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

/* Skill form */
.skill-form {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  padding-top: 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.skill-form label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.skill-form input {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  padding: 0.58rem 0.85rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.skill-form input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
}

/* ── Resume panel ── */
.resume-panel {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.resume-upload {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  border: 1px dashed var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.checkbox {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.checkbox input[type='checkbox'] {
  accent-color: var(--jl-primary);
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Resume list */
.resume-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.resume-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
}

.resume-card:hover {
  border-color: #c8d6f7;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.06);
}

.resume-card header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.resume-card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 0.15rem;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.resume-card header small {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.resume-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.chip {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
}

.chip.default {
  background: #eef3ff;
  border-color: #c8d6f7;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

/* Resume action buttons */
.resume-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.resume-actions button {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  padding: 0.38rem 0.7rem;
}

/* ── Resume insights ── */
.resume-insights {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f7f9ff, #f2f8fd);
  border: 1px solid #c8d6f7;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.4rem;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.insight-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.insight-block {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.insight-block h4 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.insight-block p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.insight-block ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.insight-block li {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
}

/* Skills inline (parsed) */
.skills-inline {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.skills-inline span {
  background: #eef8f3;
  border: 1px solid #b5e6ca;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: #1f6841;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ATS score display */
.ats-score {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
}

.ats-score strong {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  line-height: 1;
}

.ats-score span {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.ats-score small {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #19b27a;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #def8e9;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
}

.ats-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.ats-grid article {
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.2rem;
}

.ats-grid span {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ats-grid strong {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

/* Empty */
.empty {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  margin: 0;
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .layout-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .insight-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .resume-panel {
    grid-column: 1;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .resume-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/profile/candidate-profile.page.html`
```html
<section class="candidate-profile-page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1>Profile & Settings</h1>
      <p>Update your candidate profile, manage skills, and maintain your resumes/documents.</p>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="refresh" (click)="load()" [disabled]="loading()">
      {{ loading() ? 'Refreshing...' : 'Refresh' }}
    </button>
  </header>

  @if (error()) {
    <p class="banner error"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> {{ error() }}</p>
  }

  @if (success()) {
    <p class="banner success"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> {{ success() }}</p>
  }

  @if (profile(); as currentProfile) {
    <div class="layout-grid">
      <section class="panel">
        <h2>Profile information</h2>

        <form [formGroup]="profileForm" (ngSubmit)="saveProfile()" class="profile-form" novalidate>
          <label>
            Full name
            <input type="text" formControlName="fullName" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Phone
            <input type="text" formControlName="phone" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Location
            <input type="text" formControlName="location" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Current title
            <input type="text" formControlName="currentTitle" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Years of experience
            <input type="number" min="0" formControlName="yearsOfExperience" />
          </label>

          <label>
            LinkedIn URL
            <input type="text" formControlName="linkedInUrl" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Portfolio URL
            <input type="text" formControlName="portfolioUrl" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Summary
            <textarea rows="4" formControlName="summary"></textarea>
          </label>

          <button type="submit" [disabled]="savingProfile()">
            {{ savingProfile() ? 'Saving...' : 'Save profile' }}
          </button>
        </form>
      </section>

      <section class="panel">
        <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-camera" style="color:#4059aa;margin-right:.4rem"></i> Profile image</h2>

        @if (profileImageUrl()) {
          <img class="profile-image"
            [src]="profileImageUrl()"
            alt="Candidate profile"
            (error)="$event.target.style.display='none'"
          />
        } @else {
          <div class="img-placeholder">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-user-circle fa-3x" style="color:#c5c5d3"></i>
            <p class="empty">No profile image uploaded yet.</p>
          </div>
        }

        <div class="inline-actions">
          <input
            #profileImageInput
            type="file"
            accept="image/*"
            (change)="onProfileImageSelected(profileImageInput.files)"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            (click)="uploadProfileImage(); profileImageInput.value = ''"
            [disabled]="uploadingImage() || !selectedImageFile()"
          >
            <i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i>
            {{ uploadingImage() ? 'Uploading...' : 'Upload image' }}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2>Skills</h2>
          <span>{{ currentProfile.skills.length }} skills</span>
        </div>

        @if (currentProfile.skills.length === 0) {
          <p class="empty">No skills added yet.</p>
        } @else {
          <div class="skill-list">
            @for (skill of currentProfile.skills; track skill.id) {
              <article class="skill-card">
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ skill.skillName }}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {{ skill.experienceYears ?? 0 }} year(s)
                    @if (skill.proficiencyLevel) {
                      · {{ skill.proficiencyLevel }}
                    }
                  </small>
                </div>
                <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="removeSkill(skill.id)" [disabled]="isSkillRemoving(skill.id)">
                  {{ isSkillRemoving(skill.id) ? 'Removing...' : 'Remove' }}
                </button>
              </article>
            }
          </div>
        }

        <form [formGroup]="skillForm" (ngSubmit)="addSkill()" class="skill-form" novalidate>
          <label>
            Skill name
            <input type="text" formControlName="skillName" placeholder="TypeScript" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Experience years
            <input type="number" min="0" formControlName="experienceYears" />
          </label>

          <label>
            Proficiency level
            <input type="text" formControlName="proficiencyLevel" placeholder="Intermediate" />
          </label>

          <button type="submit" [disabled]="submittingSkill() || skillForm.invalid">
            {{ submittingSkill() ? 'Adding...' : 'Add skill' }}
          </button>
        </form>
      </section>

      <section class="panel resume-panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2>Documents & Resumes</h2>
          <span>{{ resumes().length }} files</span>
        </div>

        <div class="resume-upload">
          <input #resumeInput type="file" accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx" (change)="onResumeFileSelected(resumeInput.files)" />

          <label class="checkbox">
            <input #defaultToggle type="checkbox" [checked]="uploadAsDefault()" (change)="onUploadAsDefaultChanged(defaultToggle.checked)" />
            Set as default
          </label>

          <label class="checkbox">
            <input #parseToggle type="checkbox" [checked]="uploadParseNow()" (change)="onUploadParseNowChanged(parseToggle.checked)" />
            Parse after upload
          </label>

          <button type="button" (click)="uploadResume()" [disabled]="uploadingResume() || !selectedResumeFile()">
            {{ uploadingResume() ? 'Uploading...' : 'Upload resume' }}
          </button>
        </div>

        @if (resumes().length === 0) {
          <p class="empty">No resumes uploaded yet.</p>
        } @else {
          <div class="resume-list">
            @for (resume of resumes(); track resume.id) {
              <article class="resume-card">
                <header>
                  <div>
                    <h3>{{ resume.fileName }}</h3>
                    <small>
                      {{ resume.uploadedAt | date: 'mediumDate' }}
                      @if (resume.fileType) {
                        · {{ resume.fileType }}
                      }
                    </small>
                  </div>

                  <div class="resume-meta">
                    @if (resume.isDefault) {
                      <span class="chip default">Default</span>
                    }
                    <span class="chip">{{ resume.isParsed ? 'Parsed' : 'Raw' }}</span>
                    <span class="chip">ATS: {{ getDisplayedAtsScore(resume) ?? '--' }}</span>
                  </div>
                </header>

                <div class="resume-actions">
                  <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="viewResumeInsights(resume.id)" [disabled]="isResumeBusy(resume.id)">
                    {{ isResumeSelected(resume.id) ? 'Inspecting' : 'Inspect' }}
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="setDefaultResume(resume.id)" [disabled]="isResumeBusy(resume.id) || resume.isDefault">Set default</button>
                  <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="parseResume(resume.id)" [disabled]="isResumeBusy(resume.id)">Parse</button>
                  <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="fetchResumeScore(resume.id)" [disabled]="isResumeBusy(resume.id)">ATS</button>
                  <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="fillProfileFromResume(resume.id)" [disabled]="isResumeBusy(resume.id)">Fill profile</button>
                  <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="downloadResume(resume)" [disabled]="isResumeBusy(resume.id)">Download</button>
                  <button type="button" class="danger" (click)="requestDeleteResume(resume)" [disabled]="isResumeBusy(resume.id)">Delete</button>
                </div>
              </article>
            }
          </div>

          @if (selectedResume(); as inspectedResume) {
            <article class="resume-insights">
              <div class="section-head">
                <h3>Resume insights: {{ inspectedResume.fileName }}</h3>
                <button type="button" class="secondary" (click)="closeResumeInsights()">Close</button>
              </div>

              <div class="insight-grid">
                <section class="insight-block">
                  <h4>Parsing details</h4>

                  @if (inspectedResume.parsingResult) {
                    <p><strong>Name:</strong> {{ inspectedResume.parsingResult.extractedName || '--' }}</p>
                    <p><strong>Email:</strong> {{ inspectedResume.parsingResult.extractedEmail || '--' }}</p>
                    <p><strong>Phone:</strong> {{ inspectedResume.parsingResult.extractedPhone || '--' }}</p>

                    @if (inspectedResume.parsingResult.summary) {
                      <p>{{ inspectedResume.parsingResult.summary }}</p>
                    }

                    @if (inspectedResume.parsingResult.extractedSkills.length > 0) {
                      <div class="skills-inline">
                        @for (skill of inspectedResume.parsingResult.extractedSkills; track skill) {
                          <span>{{ skill }}</span>
                        }
                      </div>
                    }

                    @if (inspectedResume.parsingResult.extractedExperience.length > 0) {
                      <ul>
                        @for (item of inspectedResume.parsingResult.extractedExperience; track $index) {
                          <li>
                            <strong>{{ item.title || 'Role' }}</strong>
                            {{ item.company || '' }}
                            @if (item.duration) {
                              · {{ item.duration }}
                            }
                          </li>
                        }
                      </ul>
                    }
                  } @else {
                    <p>No parsed resume output yet. Run Parse to generate structured insights.</p>
                  }
                </section>

                <section class="insight-block">
                  <h4>ATS breakdown</h4>

                  @if (selectedAtsReport(); as report) {
                    <div class="ats-score">
                      <strong>{{ report.score }}</strong>
                      <span>/ 100</span>
                      <small>{{ report.isFriendly ? 'ATS friendly' : 'Needs improvement' }}</small>
                    </div>

                    @if (selectedAtsRows().length > 0) {
                      <div class="ats-grid">
                        @for (row of selectedAtsRows(); track row[0]) {
                          <article>
                            <span>{{ row[0] }}</span>
                            <strong>{{ row[1] }}</strong>
                          </article>
                        }
                      </div>
                    }

                    @if (report.recommendations.length > 0) {
                      <ul>
                        @for (note of report.recommendations; track note) {
                          <li>{{ note }}</li>
                        }
                      </ul>
                    }
                  } @else {
                    <p>No ATS analysis cached for this resume yet. Use the ATS action to fetch category scores and recommendations.</p>
                  }
                </section>
              </div>
            </article>
          }
        }
      </section>
    </div>
  }

  <app-confirm-dialog
    [open]="confirmDeleteResumeOpen()"
    title="Delete resume"
    [message]="'Delete resume ' + (pendingResumeDelete()?.fileName || 'selected file') + '?'"
    confirmLabel="Delete"
    cancelLabel="Cancel"
    [danger]="true"
    [busy]="pendingDeleteBusy()"
    (cancel)="cancelDeleteResume()"
    (confirm)="confirmDeleteResume()"
  ></app-confirm-dialog>
</section>
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/profile/candidate-profile.page.spec.ts`
```ts
import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { of } from 'rxjs';

import { CandidateProfileDto } from '../../../../core/models/candidate.model';
import { ResumeDto } from '../../../../core/models/resume.model';
import { CandidateService } from '../../candidate.service';
import { ResumeService } from '../../../resumes/resume.service';
import { CandidateProfilePage } from './candidate-profile.page';

describe('CandidateProfilePage', () => {
  const profile: CandidateProfileDto = {
    id: 5,
    userId: 9,
    fullName: 'Candidate One',
    email: 'candidate@example.com',
    phone: '0101001001',
    location: 'Cairo',
    currentTitle: 'Frontend Developer',
    summary: 'Focused on Angular and performance optimization.',
    linkedInUrl: null,
    portfolioUrl: null,
    profileImagePath: null,
    yearsOfExperience: 4,
    createdAt: '2026-03-01T10:00:00Z',
    updatedAt: '2026-04-01T10:00:00Z',
    skills: [],
    resumes: []
  };

  const baseResume: ResumeDto = {
    id: 21,
    candidateId: 5,
    fileName: 'candidate-one.pdf',
    fileType: 'application/pdf',
    fileSize: 1024,
    resumeText: 'Sample resume text',
    isParsed: false,
    atsScore: 67,
    atsFriendly: false,
    atsRecommendations: null,
    isDefault: true,
    uploadedAt: '2026-04-02T09:00:00Z',
    parsingResult: null
  };

  const detailedResume: ResumeDto = {
    ...baseResume,
    isParsed: true,
    parsingResult: {
      id: 31,
      parsedJson: '{"skills":["Angular"]}',
      confidence: 0.94,
      summary: 'Strong frontend profile',
      extractedName: 'Candidate One',
      extractedEmail: 'candidate@example.com',
      extractedPhone: '0101001001',
      extractedSkills: ['Angular', 'TypeScript'],
      extractedExperience: [],
      extractedEducation: []
    }
  };

  let getResumeCalls = 0;
  let getStoredResumeScoreCalls = 0;

  let candidateServiceMock: Partial<CandidateService>;
  let resumeServiceMock: Partial<ResumeService>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    getResumeCalls = 0;
    getStoredResumeScoreCalls = 0;

    candidateServiceMock = {
      getProfile: () => of({ success: true, message: 'ok', data: profile }),
      updateProfile: () => of({ success: true, message: 'updated', data: profile }),
      updateProfileImage: () =>
        of({ success: true, message: 'image uploaded', data: null }),
      addSkill: () => of({ success: true, message: 'skill added', data: null as never }),
      removeSkill: () => of({ success: true, message: 'skill removed', data: null }),
      fillFromResume: () => of({ success: true, message: 'filled', data: null })
    };

    resumeServiceMock = {
      getMyResumes: () => of({ success: true, message: 'ok', data: [baseResume] }),
      getResume: () => {
        getResumeCalls += 1;
        return of({ success: true, message: 'ok', data: detailedResume });
      },
      uploadResume: () => of({ success: true, message: 'uploaded', data: baseResume }),
      deleteResume: () => of({ success: true, message: 'deleted', data: null }),
      setDefaultResume: () => of({ success: true, message: 'default', data: null }),
      parseStoredResume: () => of({ success: true, message: 'parsed', data: null }),
      getStoredResumeAtsScore: () => {
        getStoredResumeScoreCalls += 1;
        return of({
          success: true,
          message: 'score',
          data: {
            resumeId: 21,
            score: 88,
            isFriendly: true,
            recommendations: ['Add measurable outcomes'],
            categoryScores: {
              Format: 90,
              Content: 86
            }
          }
        });
      },
      downloadResume: () => of(new Blob())
    };

    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [CandidateProfilePage],
      providers: [
        { provide: CandidateService, useValue: candidateServiceMock as unknown as CandidateService },
        { provide: ResumeService, useValue: resumeServiceMock as unknown as ResumeService }
      ]
    }).compileComponents();
  });

  it('loads profile and resume list on init', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateProfilePage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    expect(component.profile()?.id).toBe(5);
    expect(component.resumes().length).toBe(1);
    expect(component.resumes()[0].id).toBe(21);
  });

  it('fetches ATS report and updates displayed score', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateProfilePage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    component.fetchResumeScore(21);

    expect(getStoredResumeScoreCalls).toBe(1);
    expect(component.getDisplayedAtsScore(component.resumes()[0])).toBe(88);
  });

  it('loads detailed resume insights when inspecting a resume', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(CandidateProfilePage);
    fixture.detectChanges();

    const component = fixture.componentInstance;
    component.viewResumeInsights(21, true);

    expect(getResumeCalls).toBe(1);
    expect(component.selectedResumeId()).toBe(21);
    expect(component.selectedResume()?.parsingResult?.extractedSkills).toContain('Angular');
  });
});
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/profile/candidate-profile.page.ts`
```ts
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';
import { environment } from '../../../../../environments/environment';

import {
  AddSkillDto,
  CandidateProfileDto,
  ResumeBasicDto,
  UpdateCandidateProfileDto
} from '../../../../core/models/candidate.model';
import { AtsScoreDto, ResumeDto } from '../../../../core/models/resume.model';
import { CandidateService } from '../../candidate.service';
import { ResumeService } from '../../../resumes/resume.service';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../shared/components/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-profile-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ConfirmDialogComponent],
  templateUrl: './candidate-profile.page.html',
  styleUrl: './candidate-profile.page.css'
})
export class CandidateProfilePage {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly candidateService = inject(CandidateService);
  private readonly resumeService = inject(ResumeService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly savingProfile = signal(false);
  readonly uploadingImage = signal(false);
  readonly submittingSkill = signal(false);
  readonly uploadingResume = signal(false);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly success = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly profile = signal<CandidateProfileDto | null>(null);
  readonly resumes = signal<ResumeDto[]>([]);
  readonly resumeDetails = signal<Record<number, ResumeDto>>({});
  readonly atsReports = signal<Record<number, AtsScoreDto>>({});
  readonly selectedResumeId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly resumeBusy = signal<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  readonly skillRemoving = signal<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  readonly selectedResume = computed(() => {
    const resumeId = this.selectedResumeId();
    if (!resumeId) {
      return null;
    }

    const fromDetails = this.resumeDetails()[resumeId];
    if (fromDetails) {
      return fromDetails;
    }

    return this.resumes().find((item) => item.id === resumeId) ?? null;
  });

  readonly selectedAtsReport = computed(() => {
    const selected = this.selectedResume();
    if (!selected) {
      return null;
    }

    return this.atsReports()[selected.id] ?? null;
  });

  readonly selectedAtsRows = computed(() => {
    const report = this.selectedAtsReport();
    const rows = Object.entries(report?.categoryScores ?? {});
    rows.sort((left, right) => right[1] - left[1]);
    return rows;
  });

  readonly profileImageUrl = computed(() => {
    const path = this.profile()?.profileImagePath;
    if (!path) return null;
    if (path.startsWith('http')) return path;
    return `${environment.apiBaseUrl}${path}`;
  });
  readonly pendingDeleteBusy = computed(() => {
    const pending = this.pendingResumeDelete();
    return pending ? this.isResumeBusy(pending.id) : false;
  });

  readonly selectedImageFile = signal<File | null>(null);
  readonly selectedResumeFile = signal<File | null>(null);
  readonly uploadAsDefault = signal(false);
  readonly uploadParseNow = signal(true);
  readonly confirmDeleteResumeOpen = signal(false);
  readonly pendingResumeDelete = signal<ResumeDto | null>(null);

  readonly profileForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    fullName: [''],
    phone: [''],
    location: [''],
    currentTitle: [''],
    summary: [''],
    linkedInUrl: [''],
    portfolioUrl: [''],
    yearsOfExperience: ['']
  });

  readonly skillForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    skillName: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2)]],
    experienceYears: [''],
    proficiencyLevel: ['']
  });

  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      profile: this.candidateService.getProfile().pipe(
        map((res) => res.data),
        catchError(() => of(null))
      ),
      resumes: this.resumeService.getMyResumes().pipe(
        map((res) => res.data ?? []),
        catchError(() => of([] as ResumeDto[]))
      )
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ profile, resumes }) => {
          this.profile.set(profile);

          if (!profile) {
            this.error.set('Candidate profile is unavailable right now.');
            return;
          }

          this.patchProfileForm(profile);
          const mergedResumes =
            resumes.length > 0 ? resumes : this.mapProfileResumes(profile, profile.resumes)
          this.resumes.set(mergedResumes);
          this.cacheResumeDetails(mergedResumes);

          const selectedId = this.selectedResumeId();
          if (selectedId && !mergedResumes.some((resume) => resume.id === selectedId)) {
            this.selectedResumeId.set(null);
          }
        },
        error: () => {
          this.error.set('Unable to load candidate settings right now.');
        }
      });
  }

  saveProfile(): void {
    if (this.savingProfile()) {
      return;
    }

    this.savingProfile.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    const raw = this.profileForm.getRawValue();
    const payload: UpdateCandidateProfileDto = {
      fullName: raw.fullName.trim() || undefined,
      phone: raw.phone.trim() || undefined,
      location: raw.location.trim() || undefined,
      currentTitle: raw.currentTitle.trim() || undefined,
      summary: raw.summary.trim() || undefined,
      linkedInUrl: raw.linkedInUrl.trim() || undefined,
      portfolioUrl: raw.portfolioUrl.trim() || undefined,
      yearsOfExperience: this.parseNumber(raw.yearsOfExperience)
    };

    this.candidateService
      .updateProfile(payload)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.savingProfile.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Profile details updated successfully.');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to update profile details right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  onProfileImageSelected(fileList: FileList | null): void {
    this.selectedImageFile.set(fileList?.item(0) ?? null);
  }

  uploadProfileImage(): void {
    const file = this.selectedImageFile();
    if (!file || this.uploadingImage()) {
      return;
    }

    this.uploadingImage.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.candidateService
      .updateProfileImage(file)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.uploadingImage.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Profile image uploaded successfully.');
          this.selectedImageFile.set(null);
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to upload profile image right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  addSkill(): void {
    if (this.skillForm.invalid || this.submittingSkill()) {
      this.skillForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.submittingSkill.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    const raw = this.skillForm.getRawValue();
    const payload: AddSkillDto = {
      skillName: raw.skillName.trim(),
      experienceYears: this.parseNumber(raw.experienceYears),
      proficiencyLevel: raw.proficiencyLevel.trim() || undefined
    };

    this.candidateService
      .addSkill(payload)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.submittingSkill.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Skill added successfully.');
          this.skillForm.reset({
            skillName: '',
            experienceYears: '',
            proficiencyLevel: ''
          });
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to add this skill right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  isSkillRemoving(skillId: number): boolean {
    return !!this.skillRemoving()[skillId];
  }

  removeSkill(skillId: number): void {
    if (this.isSkillRemoving(skillId)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setSkillRemoving(skillId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.candidateService
      .removeSkill(skillId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setSkillRemoving(skillId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Skill removed successfully.');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to remove this skill right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  onResumeFileSelected(fileList: FileList | null): void {
    this.selectedResumeFile.set(fileList?.item(0) ?? null);
  }

  onUploadAsDefaultChanged(value: boolean): void {
    this.uploadAsDefault.set(value);
  }

  onUploadParseNowChanged(value: boolean): void {
    this.uploadParseNow.set(value);
  }

  uploadResume(): void {
    const file = this.selectedResumeFile();
    if (!file || this.uploadingResume()) {
      return;
    }

    this.uploadingResume.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.resumeService
      .uploadResume(file, this.uploadAsDefault(), this.uploadParseNow())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.uploadingResume.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Resume uploaded successfully.');
          this.selectedResumeFile.set(null);
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to upload this resume right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  isResumeBusy(resumeId: number): boolean {
    return !!this.resumeBusy()[resumeId];
  }

  setDefaultResume(resumeId: number): void {
    if (this.isResumeBusy(resumeId)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.resumeService
      .setDefaultResume(resumeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Default resume updated.');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to change default resume right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  parseResume(resumeId: number): void {
    if (this.isResumeBusy(resumeId)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.resumeService
      .parseStoredResume(resumeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Resume parsing request completed.');
          this.viewResumeInsights(resumeId, true);
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to parse this resume right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  fetchResumeScore(resumeId: number): void {
    if (this.isResumeBusy(resumeId)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.resumeService
      .getStoredResumeAtsScore(resumeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          if (res.data) {
            this.atsReports.set({
              ...this.atsReports(),
              [resumeId]: res.data
            });
            this.updateResumeInList(resumeId, (resume) => ({
              ...resume,
              atsScore: res.data?.score ?? resume.atsScore
            }));
          }
          this.success.set(res.message || 'ATS score refreshed.');
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to fetch ATS score for this resume right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  fillProfileFromResume(resumeId: number): void {
    if (this.isResumeBusy(resumeId)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.candidateService
      .fillFromResume(resumeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Profile was updated from selected resume.');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to update profile from this resume right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  downloadResume(resume: ResumeDto): void {
    const resumeId = resume.id;
    if (this.isResumeBusy(resumeId)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.resumeService
      .downloadResume(resumeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (blob) => {
          this.triggerResumeDownload(blob, resume.fileName || `resume-${resumeId}.pdf`);
          this.success.set('Resume downloaded successfully.');
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to download this resume right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  requestDeleteResume(resume: ResumeDto): void {
    if (this.isResumeBusy(resume.id)) {
      return;
    }

    this.pendingResumeDelete.set(resume);
    this.confirmDeleteResumeOpen.set(true);
  }

  cancelDeleteResume(): void {
    const pending = this.pendingResumeDelete();
    if (pending && this.isResumeBusy(pending.id)) {
      return;
    }

    this.pendingResumeDelete.set(null);
    this.confirmDeleteResumeOpen.set(false);
  }

  confirmDeleteResume(): void {
    const resume = this.pendingResumeDelete();
    if (!resume || this.isResumeBusy(resume.id)) {
      this.cancelDeleteResume();
      return;
    }

    const resumeId = resume.id;
    this.confirmDeleteResumeOpen.set(false);
    this.pendingResumeDelete.set(null);

    this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);

    this.resumeService
      .deleteResume(resumeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.success.set(res.message || 'Resume deleted successfully.');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to delete this resume right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  getDisplayedAtsScore(resume: ResumeDto): number | null {
    const reportScore = this.atsReports()[resume.id]?.score;
    if (reportScore !== undefined) {
      return reportScore;
    }

    return resume.atsScore ?? null;
  }

  viewResumeInsights(resumeId: number, force = false): void {
    this.selectedResumeId.set(resumeId);
    this.loadResumeDetails(resumeId, force);
  }

  closeResumeInsights(): void {
    this.selectedResumeId.set(null);
  }

  isResumeSelected(resumeId: number): boolean {
    return this.selectedResumeId() === resumeId;
  }

  private patchProfileForm(profile: CandidateProfileDto): void {
    this.profileForm.patchValue({
      fullName: profile.fullName || '',
      phone: profile.phone || '',
      location: profile.location || '',
      currentTitle: profile.currentTitle || '',
      summary: profile.summary || '',
      linkedInUrl: profile.linkedInUrl || '',
      portfolioUrl: profile.portfolioUrl || '',
      yearsOfExperience:
        profile.yearsOfExperience !== null && profile.yearsOfExperience !== undefined
          ? String(profile.yearsOfExperience)
          : ''
    });
  }

  private mapProfileResumes(profile: CandidateProfileDto, resumes: ResumeBasicDto[]): ResumeDto[] {
    return resumes.map((resume) => ({
      id: resume.id,
      candidateId: profile.id,
      fileName: resume.fileName,
      fileType: resume.fileType ?? null,
      fileSize: null,
      resumeText: null,
      isParsed: resume.isParsed,
      atsScore: resume.atsScore ?? null,
      atsFriendly: false,
      atsRecommendations: null,
      isDefault: resume.isDefault,
      uploadedAt: resume.uploadedAt,
      parsingResult: null
    }));
  }

  private loadResumeDetails(resumeId: number, force: boolean): void {
    if (!force && this.resumeDetails()[resumeId]) {
      return;
    }

    this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, true);

    this.resumeService
      .getResume(resumeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.setResumeBusy(resumeId, false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          const detailedResume = res.data;
          if (!detailedResume) {
            return;
          }

          this.resumeDetails.set({
            ...this.resumeDetails(),
            [resumeId]: detailedResume
          });
          this.updateResumeInList(resumeId, () => detailedResume);
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to load resume details right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  private cacheResumeDetails(resumes: ResumeDto[]): void {
    const next = { ...this.resumeDetails() };
    for (const resume of resumes) {
      next[resume.id] = resume;
    }
    this.resumeDetails.set(next);
  }

  private updateResumeInList(resumeId: number, updater: (resume: ResumeDto) => ResumeDto): void {
    const current = this.resumes();
    const index = current.findIndex((resume) => resume.id === resumeId);
    if (index < 0) {
      return;
    }

    const next = [...current];
    next[index] = updater(next[index]);
    this.resumes.set(next);
  }

  private parseNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }

    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
    }

    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      return undefined;
    }

    if (!value.trim()) {
      return undefined;
    }

    const parsed = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
      return undefined;
    }

    return parsed;
  }

  private setResumeBusy(resumeId: number, value: boolean): void {
    const next = { ...this.resumeBusy() };
    if (value) {
      next[resumeId] = true;
    } else {
      delete next[resumeId];
    }
    this.resumeBusy.set(next);
  }

  private setSkillRemoving(skillId: number, value: boolean): void {
    const next = { ...this.skillRemoving() };
    if (value) {
      next[skillId] = true;
    } else {
      delete next[skillId];
    }
    this.skillRemoving.set(next);
  }

  private triggerResumeDownload(blob: Blob, fileName: string): void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
      return;
    }

    const objectUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');
    anchor.href = objectUrl;
    anchor.download = fileName;
    anchor.click();
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  }

  private mapError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    if (err instanceof Error && err.message) {
      return err.message;
    }

    return fallback;
  }
}
```

```css
.rank-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c084fc, #a855f7); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4); }

/* Card top */
.card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

/* Score badge */
.card-score {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.05rem;
  background: #eef3ff;
  border: 1px solid #c8d6f7;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.card-score[data-tier="high"] {
  background: #def8e9;
  border-color: #b5e6ca;
}

.card-score[data-tier="mid"] {
  background: #fffbeb;
  border-color: #fde68a;
}

.score-num {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  line-height: 1;
}

.card-score[data-tier="high"] .score-num { color: #1f6841; }
.card-score[data-tier="mid"] .score-num { color: #92400e; }

.score-pct {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.card-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.card-company {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

/* Match reason */
.match-reason {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Skills */
.skills-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.skill-tag {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  border: 1px solid #b5e6ca;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: #1f6841;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.skill-more {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
}

/* Details link */
.btn-details {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--jl-primary);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-top: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.2);
  transition: opacity 0.12s, transform 0.12s;
  align-self: flex-start;
}

.btn-details:hover {
  opacity: 0.85;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .cards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .cards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .page-header {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}
```

```html
<section class="recommendations-page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1>
        <i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles" style="color:#4059aa;margin-right:.5rem"></i>
        AI Job Recommendations
      </h1>
      <p>Personalized opportunities ranked by your profile, ATS performance, and activity.</p>
      @if (lastUpdated()) {
        <small class="last-updated">
          <i class="fa-regular fa-clock"></i>
          Last updated: {{ lastUpdated() | date: 'MMM d, h:mm a' }}
        </small>
      }
    </div>
    <div class="header-actions">
      <a class="btn-browse" routerLink="/candidate/jobs">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i> Browse All Jobs
      </a>
      <button type="button" class="btn-refresh-ai" (click)="refreshFromAi()" [disabled]="loading() || refreshing()">
        @if (refreshing()) {
          <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Refreshing AI…
        } @else {
          <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> Refresh AI Ranking
        }
      </button>
    </div>
  </header>

  @if (error()) {
    <div class="alert-error">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> {{ error() }}
    </div>
  }

  @if (info() && !error()) {
    <div class="alert-info">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i> {{ info() }}
    </div>
  }

  @if (loading()) {
    <div class="cards-grid">
      @for (i of [1,2,3,4,5,6]; track i) {
        <div class="sk-rec-card">
          <div class="sk-badge"></div>
          <div class="sk-line wide"></div>
          <div class="sk-line med"></div>
          <div class="sk-line short"></div>
        </div>
      }
    </div>
  } @else if (recommendations().length === 0) {
    <div class="empty-panel">
      <span class="empty-icon">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass-chart"></i>
      </span>
      <h2>No recommendations yet</h2>
      <p>Upload and parse your resume to unlock AI job matching.</p>
      <div class="empty-actions">
        <a class="btn-primary" routerLink="/candidate/profile">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i> Update Profile &amp; Resume
        </a>
        <a class="btn-secondary" routerLink="/candidate/jobs">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-list"></i> Browse Jobs Manually
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  } @else {
    <div class="cards-grid">
      @for (rec of recommendations(); track trackByJobId($index, rec); let i = $index) {
        <article class="rec-card" [class.rec-card--top]="i < 3">
          @if (i < 3) {
            <div class="rank-badge rank-{{ i + 1 }}">#{{ i + 1 }}</div>
          }

          <div class="card-top">
            <div class="card-score" [attr.data-tier]="getScoreTier(rec.matchScore)">
              <span class="score-num">{{ rec.matchScore }}</span>
              <span class="score-pct">%</span>
            </div>
            <div class="card-info">
              <h2 class="card-title">{{ rec.title }}</h2>
              <p class="card-company">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-building" style="opacity:.5;margin-right:.2rem"></i>
                {{ rec.companyName || 'Company' }} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {{ rec.location || 'Remote' }}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          @if (rec.matchReason) {
            <p class="match-reason">"{{ rec.matchReason }}"</p>
          }

          @if (rec.matchingSkills.length > 0) {
            <div class="skills-row">
              @for (skill of rec.matchingSkills.slice(0, 5); track skill) {
                <span class="skill-tag">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> {{ skill }}
                </span>
              }
              @if (rec.matchingSkills.length > 5) {
                <span class="skill-more">+{{ rec.matchingSkills.length - 5 }} more</span>
              }
            </div>
          }

          <a class="btn-details" [routerLink]="['/candidate/jobs', rec.jobId]">
            View Details <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
          </a>
        </article>
      }
    </div>
  }
</section>
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/candidates/pages/recommendations/candidate-recommendations.page.ts`
```ts
import { CommonModule, DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { JobRecommendationDto } from '../../../../core/models/job.model';
import { JobsService } from '../../../jobs/jobs.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-recommendations-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, DatePipe],
  templateUrl: './candidate-recommendations.page.html',
  styleUrl: './candidate-recommendations.page.css'
})
export class CandidateRecommendationsPage {
  private readonly jobsService = inject(JobsService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly refreshing = signal(false);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly info = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly recommendations = signal<JobRecommendationDto[]>([]);
  readonly lastUpdated = signal<Date | null>(null);

  constructor() {
    this.load(false);
  }

  load(forceRefresh = false): void {
    if (forceRefresh) {
      this.refreshing.set(true);
    } else {
      this.loading.set(true);
    }

    this.error.set(null);
    this.info.set(null);

    this.jobsService
      .getCandidateRecommendations(30, forceRefresh)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => {
          this.loading.set(false);
          this.refreshing.set(false);
        })
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          const items = res.data ?? [];
          this.recommendations.set(items);
          this.info.set(items.length === 0 ? (res.message ?? null) : null);
          this.lastUpdated.set(new Date());
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to load recommendations right now.'));
        }
      });
  }

  refreshFromAi(): void {
    if (this.refreshing()) {
      return;
    }

    this.load(true);
  }

  getScoreTier(score: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (score === null || score === undefined) return 'low';
    if (score >= 80) return 'high';
    if (score >= 60) return 'mid';
    return 'low';
  }

  trackByJobId(_: number, item: JobRecommendationDto): number {
    return item.jobId;
  }

  private mapError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    if (err instanceof Error && err.message) {
      return err.message;
    }

    return fallback;
  }
}
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/chat/pages/chat-window/chat-window.page.html`
```html
<div class="chat-container">
  <!-- Header -->
  <div class="chat-header">
    <div class="header-left">
      <button class="btn-icon back-btn" (click)="goBack()" title="Go Back">
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
      </button>
      <div class="recipient-info">
        <div class="recipient-avatar">
          <!-- We can just show a placeholder or dynamic avatar -->
          <i class="fas fa-user"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="recipient-text">
          <h2 class="recipient-name">Conversation</h2>
          <span class="recipient-status">Online</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Messages Area -->
  <div class="messages-area" #messagesContainer>
    <div *ngIf="loading" class="chat-loading">
      <div class="spinner"></div>
    </div>

    <div *ngFor="let msg of messages" 
         class="message-wrapper" 
         [class.message-outgoing]="msg.senderId === currentUserId" 
         [class.message-incoming]="msg.senderId !== currentUserId">
      
      <div class="message-meta" *ngIf="msg.senderId !== currentUserId">
        <span class="sender-name">{{ msg.senderName }}</span>
        <time class="message-time">{{ msg.sentAtUtc | date:'shortTime' }}</time>
      </div>

      <div class="message-bubble" [class.bubble-primary]="msg.senderId === currentUserId">
        <p class="message-text">{{ msg.content }}</p>
        
        <div *ngIf="msg.attachments && msg.attachments.length" class="attachments-list">
          <a *ngFor="let att of msg.attachments" [href]="att.fileUrl" target="_blank" class="attachment-link">
            <i class="fas fa-paperclip"></i> {{ att.fileName }}
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="message-meta-bottom" *ngIf="msg.senderId === currentUserId">
        <time class="message-time">{{ msg.sentAtUtc | date:'shortTime' }}</time>
        <span class="message-status">
          <i class="fas" [class.fa-check]="!msg.isRead" [class.fa-check-double]="msg.isRead" [class.text-primary]="msg.isRead"></i>
          {{ msg.isRead ? 'Read' : 'Delivered' }}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Input Area -->
  <div class="chat-input-area">
    <form (ngSubmit)="sendMessage()" class="chat-form">
      <button type="button" class="btn-icon attachment-btn" title="Attach file">
        <i class="fas fa-paperclip"></i>
      </button>
      <input 
        type="text" 
        [(ngModel)]="newMessage" 
        name="newMessage"
        placeholder="Type a message..." 
        class="message-input"
        autocomplete="off"
        required
      />
      <button type="submit" class="btn-primary send-btn" [disabled]="!newMessage.trim() || sending">
        <div *ngIf="sending" class="spinner spinner-small"></div>
        <i *ngIf="!sending" class="fas fa-paper-plane"></i>
      </button>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/chat/pages/chat-window/chat-window.page.ts`
```ts
import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, inject, ViewChild, ElementRef, AfterViewChecked, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ChatService, ChatMessageDto } from '../../../../core/services/chat.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../../core/auth/auth.service';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-chat-window-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './chat-window.page.html',
  styleUrl: './chat-window.page.css'
})
export class ChatWindowPage implements OnInit, OnDestroy, AfterViewChecked {
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private chatService = inject(ChatService);
  private authService = inject(AuthService);
  private cdr = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);

  @ViewChild('messagesContainer') private messagesContainer!: ElementRef;

  conversationId!: number;
  messages: ChatMessageDto[] = [];
  currentUserId!: number;
  newMessage = '';
  loading = true;
  sending = false;

  private sub?: Subscription;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.currentUserId = this.authService.currentUser()?.userId || 0;
    
    this.route.paramMap.subscribe(params => {
      const idStr = params.get('conversationId');
      if (idStr) {
        this.conversationId = parseInt(idStr, 10);
        this.loadMessages();
        this.markAsRead();
      }
    });

    this.sub = new Subscription();
    this.sub.add(
      this.chatService.incomingMessage$.subscribe(msg => {
        if (msg && msg.conversationId === this.conversationId) {
          // If we didn't send it, it might not be in the list, or it's new
          const exists = this.messages.find(m => m.id === msg.id);
          if (!exists) {
            this.messages.push(msg);
            this.scrollToBottom();
            if (msg.senderId !== this.currentUserId) {
               this.markAsRead();
            }
            this.cdr.detectChanges();
          }
        }
      })
    );

    this.sub.add(
      this.chatService.messagesRead$.subscribe(convId => {
        if (convId === this.conversationId) {
          this.messages.forEach(m => {
            if (m.senderId === this.currentUserId) m.isRead = true;
          });
          this.cdr.detectChanges();
        }
      })
    );
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.sub?.unsubscribe();
  }

  ngAfterViewChecked() {
    // Only scroll if we are near the bottom, or just forcefully for this demo
  }

  loadMessages() {
    this.loading = true;
    this.chatService.getMessages(this.conversationId, 0, 100).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.messages = data;
        this.loading = false;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
        setTimeout(() => this.scrollToBottom(), 100);
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.error('Failed to load messages', err);
        this.loading = false;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      }
    });
  }

  markAsRead() {
    this.chatService.markAsRead(this.conversationId).subscribe();
  }

  async sendMessage() {
    if (!this.newMessage.trim()) return;

    // We need the receiverId. We can infer it from the messages if there are any, 
    // or we'd need a GetConversation API call. Let's fetch it from the first message that isn't us.
    let receiverId = 0;
    const otherMsg = this.messages.find(m => m.senderId !== this.currentUserId);
    if (otherMsg) {
       receiverId = otherMsg.senderId;
    } else {
       // We might not have a receiverId easily available here if conversation has no messages
       // In a real app we'd load the conversation details too. 
       // For now, let's assume we fetch conversation detail first or we got here from a button.
       // As a fallback, we need to load conversation.
    }

    if (!receiverId) {
       // Let's get it from the conversation list
       this.chatService.getConversations().subscribe(async convs => {
          const conv = convs.find(c => c.id === this.conversationId);
          if (conv) {
             await this.executeSend(conv.otherParticipantId);
          }
       });
    } else {
       await this.executeSend(receiverId);
    }
  }

  private async executeSend(receiverId: number) {
    this.sending = true;
    try {
      await this.chatService.sendMessageRealtime({
        receiverId: receiverId,
        content: this.newMessage
      });
      this.newMessage = '';
      this.scrollToBottom();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to send message', err);
    } finally {
      this.sending = false;
    }
  }

  goBack() {
    const role = this.authService.currentUser()?.role;
    if (role === 'Recruiter' || role === 'Admin') {
      this.router.navigate(['/recruiter/chat']);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['/candidate/chat']);
    }
  }

  private scrollToBottom(): void {
    try {
      this.messagesContainer.nativeElement.scrollTop = this.messagesContainer.nativeElement.scrollHeight;
    } catch (err) { }
  }
}
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/chat/pages/inbox/inbox.page.ts`
```ts
import { Component, OnInit, inject, OnDestroy, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Router, RouterModule, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { ChatService, ChatConversationDto } from '../../../../core/services/chat.service';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { AuthService } from '../../../../core/auth/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inbox-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterModule],
  templateUrl: './inbox.page.html',
  styleUrl: './inbox.page.css'
})
export class InboxPage implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private chatService = inject(ChatService);
  private authService = inject(AuthService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private cdr = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  
  conversations: ChatConversationDto[] = [];
  loading = true;
  private sub?: Subscription;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.route.queryParams.subscribe(params => {
      const receiverId = Number(params['receiverId']);
      if (receiverId) {
        this.chatService.getOrCreateConversation(receiverId).subscribe({
          next: (conv) => {
            this.openConversation(conv.id);
          },
          error: (err) => {
            console.error('Failed to create conversation', err);
            this.loadConversations();
          }
        });
      } else {
        this.loadConversations();
      }
    });

    // Re-fetch conversations if a new message arrives so preview/unread updates
    this.sub = this.chatService.incomingMessage$.subscribe(msg => {
      if (msg) {
        this.loadConversations();
      }
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.sub?.unsubscribe();
  }

  loadConversations() {
    this.chatService.getConversations().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.conversations = data;
        this.loading = false;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.error('Failed to load conversations', err);
        this.loading = false;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      }
    });
  }

  openConversation(id: number) {
    const role = this.authService.currentUser()?.role;
    if (role === 'Recruiter' || role === 'Admin') {
      this.router.navigate(['/recruiter/chat', id]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['/candidate/chat', id]);
    }
  }
}
```

### `frontend-angular/src/app/features/interviews/interview-realtime.service.ts`
```ts
import { Injectable, NgZone, inject } from '@angular/core';
import {
  HubConnection,
  HubConnectionBuilder,
  HubConnectionState,
  LogLevel,
} from '@microsoft/signalr';
import { BehaviorSubject, Observable, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { environment } from '../../../environments/environment';
import { TokenStoreService } from '../../core/auth/token-store.service';

export interface AudioProcessedEvent {
  transcript: string;
  reply: string;
  isComplete: boolean;
  score?: number;
  replyAudioBase64?: string;
  replyAudioMimeType?: string;
}

export interface ProctoringAlertEvent {
  eventType: string;
  severity: string;
  source: string;
  description: string;
}

export type VadState = 'idle' | 'listening' | 'speaking' | 'processing' | 'playing';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class InterviewRealtimeService {
  private readonly tokenStore = inject(TokenStoreService);
  private readonly zone = inject(NgZone);

  private hubConnection: HubConnection | null = null;
  private audioContext: AudioContext | null = null;
  private mediaStream: MediaStream | null = null;
  private processorNode: ScriptProcessorNode | null = null;
  private inputSource: MediaStreamAudioSourceNode | null = null;

  private currentSequence = 1;
  private activeSessionId: number | null = null;

  // VAD Thresholds & Adaptive State
  private readonly SAMPLE_RATE = 16000;
  private readonly BUFFER_SIZE = 4096;
  private readonly SPEECH_START_THRESHOLD = 0.045;
  private readonly SPEECH_END_THRESHOLD = 0.018;
  private readonly HANGOVER_TIME_MS = 1400; // Time in silence before utterance cutoff
  private readonly MIN_SPEECH_DURATION_MS = 400; // Reject clicks/puffs

  private isSpeaking = false;
  private speechStartTime = 0;
  private lastActiveTime = 0;
  private audioChunks: Float32Array[] = [];

  // Observables
  private readonly vadStateSubject = new BehaviorSubject<VadState>('idle');
  public readonly vadState$ = this.vadStateSubject.asObservable();

  private readonly audioProcessedSubject = new Subject<AudioProcessedEvent>();
  public readonly audioProcessed$ = this.audioProcessedSubject.asObservable();

  private readonly proctoringEventSubject = new Subject<ProctoringAlertEvent>();
  public readonly proctoringEvent$ = this.proctoringEventSubject.asObservable();

  private readonly volumeLevelSubject = new BehaviorSubject<number>(0);
  public readonly volumeLevel$ = this.volumeLevelSubject.asObservable();

  public async connect(sessionId: number): Promise<void> {
    if (this.hubConnection && this.hubConnection.state === HubConnectionState.Connected) {
      if (this.activeSessionId === sessionId) return;
      await this.disconnect();
    }

    this.activeSessionId = sessionId;
    const hubUrl = `${environment.apiBaseUrl}/hubs/interview`;

    this.hubConnection = new HubConnectionBuilder()
      .withUrl(hubUrl, {
        accessTokenFactory: () => this.tokenStore.getAccessToken() || '',
      })
      .withAutomaticReconnect([0, 2000, 5000, 10000])
      .configureLogging(environment.production ? LogLevel.None : LogLevel.Information)
      .build();

    this.registerServerEvents();

    await this.hubConnection.start();
    await this.hubConnection.invoke('JoinSession', sessionId);
  }

  public async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
    this.stopAudioCapture();

    if (this.hubConnection) {
      if (this.activeSessionId && this.hubConnection.state === HubConnectionState.Connected) {
        try {
          await this.hubConnection.invoke('LeaveSession', this.activeSessionId);
        } catch {
          // Socket might already be closing
        }
      }
      await this.hubConnection.stop();
      this.hubConnection = null;
    }

    this.activeSessionId = null;
    this.vadStateSubject.next('idle');
  }

  public async startAudioCapture(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.audioContext && this.audioContext.state === 'running') {
      return;
    }

    this.mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      audio: {
        channelCount: 1,
        sampleRate: this.SAMPLE_RATE,
        echoCancellation: true,
        noiseSuppression: true,
        autoGainControl: true,
      },
      video: false,
    });

    this.audioContext = new (
      window.AudioContext ||
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext
    )({
      sampleRate: this.SAMPLE_RATE,
    });

    if (this.audioContext.state === 'suspended') {
      await this.audioContext.resume();
    }

    this.inputSource = this.audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(this.mediaStream);
    this.processorNode = this.audioContext.createScriptProcessor(this.BUFFER_SIZE, 1, 1);

    this.processorNode.onaudioprocess = (e) => {
      const input = e.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0);
      this.processAudioFrame(input);
    };

    this.inputSource.connect(this.processorNode);
    this.processorNode.connect(this.audioContext.destination);

    this.vadStateSubject.next('listening');
  }

  public stopAudioCapture(): void {
    if (this.processorNode) {
      this.processorNode.disconnect();
      this.processorNode.onaudioprocess = null;
      this.processorNode = null;
    }

    if (this.inputSource) {
      this.inputSource.disconnect();
      this.inputSource = null;
    }

    if (this.audioContext) {
      this.audioContext.close();
      this.audioContext = null;
    }

    if (this.mediaStream) {
      this.mediaStream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      this.mediaStream = null;
    }

    this.isSpeaking = false;
    this.audioChunks = [];
    this.volumeLevelSubject.next(0);
  }

  public async submitVideoFrame(base64Frame: string): Promise<void> {
    if (
      !this.hubConnection ||
      this.hubConnection.state !== HubConnectionState.Connected ||
      !this.activeSessionId
    ) {
      return;
    }

    await this.hubConnection.invoke(
      'SubmitVideoFrame',
      this.activeSessionId,
      base64Frame,
      this.currentSequence,
    );
  }

  public async requestOpeningPrompt(): Promise<void> {
    if (
      !this.hubConnection ||
      this.hubConnection.state !== HubConnectionState.Connected ||
      !this.activeSessionId
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.vadStateSubject.next('processing');
    await this.hubConnection.invoke('RequestOpeningPrompt', this.activeSessionId);
  }

  private processAudioFrame(samples: Float32Array): void {
    const rms = this.calculateRms(samples);
    this.volumeLevelSubject.next(Math.min(1, rms * 8));

    const now = performance.now();

    if (!this.isSpeaking) {
      // Check Speech Onset
      if (rms >= this.SPEECH_START_THRESHOLD) {
        this.isSpeaking = true;
        this.speechStartTime = now;
        this.lastActiveTime = now;
        this.audioChunks = [new Float32Array(samples)];
        this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('speaking'));
      }
    } else {
      // Candidate is actively speaking
      this.audioChunks.push(new Float32Array(samples));

      if (rms >= this.SPEECH_END_THRESHOLD) {
        this.lastActiveTime = now;
      } else {
        // Evaluate Hangover silence interval
        const silenceDuration = now - this.lastActiveTime;
        const totalSpeechDuration = now - this.speechStartTime;

        if (silenceDuration >= this.HANGOVER_TIME_MS) {
          if (totalSpeechDuration >= this.MIN_SPEECH_DURATION_MS) {
            this.finalizeUtterance();
          } else {
            // Noise burst / click - discard
            this.isSpeaking = false;
            this.audioChunks = [];
            this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('listening'));
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private finalizeUtterance(): void {
    this.isSpeaking = false;
    this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('processing'));

    const mergedSamples = this.mergeAudioBuffers(this.audioChunks);
    this.audioChunks = [];

    const wavBlob = this.encodeWav(mergedSamples, this.SAMPLE_RATE);
    this.convertBlobToBase64(wavBlob).then((base64) => {
      this.sendAudioChunk(base64);
    });
  }

  private async sendAudioChunk(base64Payload: string): Promise<void> {
    if (
      !this.hubConnection ||
      this.hubConnection.state !== HubConnectionState.Connected ||
      !this.activeSessionId
    ) {
      this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('listening'));
      return;
    }

    try {
      await this.hubConnection.invoke(
        'SubmitAudio',
        this.activeSessionId,
        base64Payload,
        this.currentSequence++,
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to stream audio chunk to SignalR Hub', err);
      this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('listening'));
    }
  }

  private registerServerEvents(): void {
    if (!this.hubConnection) return;

    this.hubConnection.on(
      'audioProcessed',
      (res: { success: boolean; data: AudioProcessedEvent }) => {
        this.zone.run(() => {
          if (res?.success && res.data) {
            this.audioProcessedSubject.next(res.data);
            if (res.data.replyAudioBase64) {
              this.playAssistantAudio(res.data.replyAudioBase64, res.data.replyAudioMimeType);
            } else {
              this.vadStateSubject.next('listening');
            }
          } else {
            this.vadStateSubject.next('listening');
          }
        });
      },
    );

    this.hubConnection.on(
      'videoProcessed',
      (res: { success: boolean; data: { events: ProctoringAlertEvent[] } }) => {
        this.zone.run(() => {
          if (res?.success && res.data?.events) {
            for (const ev of res.data.events) {
              this.proctoringEventSubject.next(ev);
            }
          }
        });
      },
    );
  }

  private playAssistantAudio(base64Audio: string, mimeType = 'audio/wav'): void {
    this.vadStateSubject.next('playing');
    const audioUrl = `data:${mimeType};base64,${base64Audio}`;
    const audio = new Audio(audioUrl);

    audio.onended = () => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('listening'));
    };

    audio.onerror = () => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('listening'));
    };

    audio.play().catch(() => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.vadStateSubject.next('listening'));
    });
  }

  private calculateRms(samples: Float32Array): number {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
      sum += samples[i] * samples[i];
    }
    return Math.sqrt(sum / samples.length);
  }

  private mergeAudioBuffers(buffers: Float32Array[]): Float32Array {
    let totalLen = 0;
    for (const b of buffers) totalLen += b.length;
    const result = new Float32Array(totalLen);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const b of buffers) {
      result.set(b, offset);
      offset += b.length;
    }
    return result;
  }

  private encodeWav(samples: Float32Array, sampleRate: number): Blob {
    const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2);
    const view = new DataView(buffer);

    this.writeString(view, 0, 'RIFF');
    view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2, true);
    this.writeString(view, 8, 'WAVE');
    this.writeString(view, 12, 'fmt ');
    view.setUint32(16, 16, true);
    view.setUint16(20, 1, true); // PCM format
    view.setUint16(22, 1, true); // Mono
    view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true);
    view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true);
    view.setUint16(32, 2, true);
    view.setUint16(34, 16, true);
    this.writeString(view, 36, 'data');
    view.setUint32(40, samples.length * 2, true);

    let index = 44;
    for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
      const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
      view.setInt16(index, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff, true);
      index += 2;
    }

    return new Blob([view], { type: 'audio/wav' });
  }

  private writeString(view: DataView, offset: number, string: string): void {
    for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
      view.setUint8(offset + i, string.charCodeAt(i));
    }
  }

  private convertBlobToBase64(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => {
        const dataUrl = reader.result as string;
        resolve(dataUrl.split(',')[1]);
      };
      reader.onerror = reject;
      reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
  }
}
```
